articles.title: From DQI to C-DQI: Automatic Codebook Generation and Evaluation for Measuring Computational Discourse Quality Index
articles.abstract: Effective democratic deliberation is vital for civic engagement and the health of legislative institutions. However, assessing parliamentary discourse quality is traditionally done using expert-scored, theory-based codebooks (CBs), which are rigid, labor-intensive, and prone to biases. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a scalable alternative for both schema induction and discourse annotation, ensuring schema quality and mitigating models' inherent bias remains a clear challenge. In this work, we propose a complete protocol for LLM-based codebook generation and evaluation. Starting from the widely accepted discourse quality Index (DQI), we compare top-down (theory-based), bottom-up (data-driven), and hybrid approaches for generating context-adapted schemas. To evaluate these schemas, we define an extrinsic proxy measure, validated by manual annotations, alongside an intrinsic inter-model agreement (IMA) metric, which leverages differing model biases to signal overall reliability. Our experiments on 100 Israeli parliament transcripts reveal that inductive, data-driven schemas achieve higher IMA than top-down methods while maintaining validity, demonstrating their potential for reliable, large-scale analysis of political discourse.
articles.titleCn: 从DQI到C-DQI：用于衡量计算话语质量指数的自动代码本生成与评估
articles.abstractCn: 有效的民主审议对于公民参与和立法机构健康发展至关重要。然而，传统上评估议会话语质量是通过基于理论的专家评分代码簿（CB），这些代码簿僵化、费时且易产生偏见。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）为模式归纳和话语标注提供了可扩展的替代方案，但确保模式质量和缓解模型固有偏见仍然是一个明确挑战。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于LLM的代码簿生成与评估完整协议。从广泛接受的对话质量指数（DQI）出发，我们比较了自上而下（基于理论）、自下而上（数据驱动）和混合方法在生成情境适应模式方面的效果。为评估这些模式，我们定义了一个外生代理指标，并通过人工标注验证，同时采用一种内在模型间一致性（IMA）指标，该指标利用不同的模型偏见来指示整体可靠性。我们对100份以色列议会记录进行的实验表明，归纳式、数据驱动的模式在保持有效性的同时实现了比自上而下方法更高的IMA，证明了其在政治话语可靠、大规模分析方面的潜力。

articles.title: Why Do LLMs Accept Generics? Explaining Acceptability using Psycholinguistic and Model-Derived Factors
articles.abstract: Psycholinguistic studies explore why humans accept some generic statements but reject others by showing that these judgments depend on more than how common a property is. People consider several other factors such as how well it sets the kind apart from others or whether it is characteristic of the kind. Inspired by the linguistic and cognitive literature, we explore to what extent factors from these studies explain how large language models (LLMs) judge generics. Our results with twelve models on a psycholinguistic dataset and on naturally occurring generics show that models weigh how common a property is against how well it distinguishes the kind, and combine the two much as people do, though less clearly. Like people, they favor characteristic properties, but unlike the accounts of human judgment, they ignore striking ones. What matters most to LLMs is whether a statement is factually true, and much of the influence of human factors reaches their ratings through that judgment. In six 7-9B models, shifting the hidden states along each factor's direction moves the judgment as the factor predicts.
articles.titleCn: 为什么大型语言模型接受泛型？使用心理语言学和模型衍生因素解释其可接受性
articles.abstractCn: 心理语言学研究表明，人类接受某些泛指性陈述而拒绝另一些，是因为这些判断不仅取决于某种属性有多普遍。人们会考虑其他因素，例如这种属性是否能让该类别与其他类别有效区分开来，或者它是否是该类别的典型特征。受语言学和认知学文献的启发，我们探讨了这些研究中的因素在多大程度上解释了大型语言模型（LLM）如何判断泛指性陈述。我们在心理语言学数据集和自然泛指性陈述上对十二个模型进行测试的结果表明，模型会权衡某种属性的普遍程度以及它如何有效区分该类别，并将两者结合起来，尽管不如人类那样清晰。与人类一样，它们偏爱典型属性，但与人类判断的描述不同，它们忽略了显著的属性。对LLM来说，最重要的是陈述是否事实为真，而人类因素的影响大多是通过这一判断来影响它们的评分的。在六个7-9B模型中，沿着每个因素的方向移动隐藏状态，会使判断按照该因素预测的方式移动。

articles.title: ACE-Compression: An Ability-Centric Evaluation of Compressed Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Model compression makes large language models deployable, but today's evaluation tells an incomplete story. Standard practice measures retained task performance and stops there. This misses a critical fact: compression perturbs the distributed knowledge embedded across billions of weights, and task scores alone cannot reveal which underlying abilities survive and which quietly collapse. To solve this question, we introduce ACE-Compression, an ability-centric evaluation framework. Instead of asking only "does the compressed model still answer correctly?", we ask "which of its core abilities remain intact?" Our framework probes four deployment-facing dimensions: procedural reasoning and constraint execution, knowledge grounding and truthfulness, social cognition and affective understanding, and persona fidelity and stylistic consistency. Across more than 35 compressed checkpoints from six open-weight LLMs-covering quantization and pruning-we find that compression redistributes ability profiles. Coarse, local, and surface-level signals often persist, while fine-grained, long-tail, and context-dependent abilities become fragile. Quantization consistently outperforms pruning in retention, but the practical meaning of that gap depends entirely on which ability an application requires. Based on our findings, deployers can choose compression methods by the ability profile their application needs, not just by a leaderboard average. And algorithm designers gain diagnostic signals to build compression methods that preserve what matters. We believe that ACE-Compression turns compression from a black-box accuracy drop into an interpretable intervention-one we can measure, understand, and ultimately improve.
articles.comment: 33 pages, 7 figures, including references and appendices. Code: https://github.com/gaffeyn03/ACE-Compression
articles.titleCn: ACE-压缩：一种以能力为中心的压缩大型语言模型评估
articles.abstractCn: 模型压缩使大型语言模型得以部署，但目前的评估却未能全面反映情况。标准做法仅测量保留的任务性能，然后就此止步。这忽略了一个关键事实：压缩会扰动分布在数十亿权重中的分布式知识，而仅凭任务分数无法揭示哪些底层能力得以保留，哪些能力则悄然崩溃。为解决这一问题，我们引入了以能力为中心的评估框架ACE-Compression。我们不再仅问“压缩后的模型是否仍能正确回答？”，而是问“其核心能力中哪些得以完好保留？”我们的框架探究了四个与部署相关的维度：程序推理与约束执行、知识基础与真实性、社会认知与情感理解，以及角色一致性与风格一致性。通过对六种开源大型语言模型的35个以上压缩检查点（涵盖量化和剪枝）的评估，我们发现压缩会重新分配能力配置。粗略、局部和表面层次的信号往往得以保留，而精细、长尾和依赖上下文的能力则变得脆弱。量化始终在保留方面优于剪枝，但这一差距的实际意义完全取决于应用所需的能力。基于我们的发现，部署者可以根据应用所需的能力配置选择压缩方法，而不仅仅是根据排行榜平均分。算法设计者则获得了诊断信号，用以构建能够保留重要内容的压缩方法。我们相信，ACE-Compression将压缩从黑盒精度下降转变为可解释的干预——一种我们可以测量、理解并最终改进的方法。

articles.title: Polarity Blindness in LLM Safety: A Systematic Study of Negation, Antonym Substitution, and Adversarial Framing
articles.abstract: Negation remains a persistent challenge for language models across NLP tasks and modalities. We show that this weakness can undermine LLM safety guardrails through a structural vulnerability we term polarity blindness: the failure to recognize harmful intent after polarity-altering linguistic transformations. We study two forms of polarity inversion: grammatical negation and antonym replacement, and use synonym replacement as a polarity-preserving control. We further test whether an adversarial textual wrapper amplifies these failures. Using a 260-prompt benchmark across 10 state-of-the-art LLMs and 3 languages (English, Spanish, Czech), stratified by harmfulness potential and evaluated on a validated 0-5 harm scale, we find that polarity blindness affects most evaluated models, with mean harm scores reaching 4.12 for the most vulnerable model. The effect persists across typologically differing negation systems, suggesting that polarity blindness reflects a broader limitation in semantic robustness rather than a language- or grammar-specific failure.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型安全中的极性盲点：否定、反义替换和对抗性框架的系统研究
articles.abstractCn: 否定仍然是在各种自然语言处理任务和模态中语言模型持续面临的挑战。我们表明这种弱点可以通过我们称之为极性盲点的一种结构脆弱性削弱大型语言模型的安全防护机制：即在经过改变极性的语言转换后无法识别有害意图。我们研究了两种极性反转的形式：语法否定和反义词替换，并使用同义词替换作为保持极性的对照。我们进一步测试了对抗性文本包装是否放大了这些失败。使用一个包含10个最先进的语言模型和3种语言（英语、西班牙语、捷克语）的260条提示基准测试，并根据有害性潜力分层，并在经过验证的0-5危害量表上评估，我们发现极性盲点影响了大多数评估模型，其中最脆弱模型的平均危害分数达到4.12。这种效应在不同的否定系统类型中仍然存在，表明极性盲点反映了语义鲁棒性更广泛的局限性，而不仅仅是特定语言或语法上的失败。

articles.title: Staged Continual Adaptation of Multimodal Foundation Models for Japanese Financial Documents
articles.abstract: Staged post-training of multimodal foundation models chains vision-language alignment, reasoning distillation, and domain tuning, yet how each phase trades capabilities against the others remains under-characterised. Tracking an 8.4B-parameter model from an un-fine-tuned baseline through three training phases on Japanese financial documents (evaluated on five text-input benchmarks), we find the phases interact non-additively: math-only distillation overwrites the financial knowledge acquired earlier even as procedural math skill survives, and the domain phase repairs more than it installs. A skip-phase ablation is best for domain knowledge but forfeits numerical-reasoning gains, so per-phase contributions are not decomposable and the best checkpoint is task-dependent, with implications for checkpoint retention and scheduling rather than added stages.
articles.comment: 17 pages, 10 figures, 9 tables. Presented at the ICML 2026 Workshop "Continual Adaptation at Scale: Towards Sustainable AI". Code: https://github.com/AtsushiYanaigsawa768/Compass
articles.titleCn: 针对日本金融文件的多模态基础模型的分阶段持续适应
articles.abstractCn: 多模态基础模型在训练后进行分阶段优化，涵盖了视觉-语言对齐、推理蒸馏和领域微调，但各阶段在能力权衡方面的特性尚未充分表征。通过对一个8.4B参数模型从未经微调的基线开始，经过三个训练阶段在日语金融文档（在五个文本输入基准上评估）的跟踪，我们发现各阶段之间存在非加性交互：仅数学蒸馏会覆盖早期获得的金融知识，即使程序性数学技能得以保留，而领域阶段修复的远多于其安装的。跳过阶段的消融实验表明，领域知识最佳但会损失数值推理的增益，因此各阶段的贡献不可分解，最佳检查点依赖于任务，这对检查点保留和调度而非增加阶段具有启示意义。

articles.title: CollabSciReM: Aligning Language Models for Scientific Conversations via Science-Aware Reward Decomposition
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as research collaborators for hypothesis refinement, methodological planning, and technical analysis across multi-turn interactions. In this setting, a useful assistant must be accurate, methodologically justified, logically consistent, and token-efficient. Current alignment approaches rarely achieve all of these together. Instruction-tuned models gain conversational quality through verbosity, and we show that science-agnostic general collaborative rewards compress responses at the expense of scientific rigor. We propose CollabSciReM, a goal-conditioned reward framework that decomposes the session-level reward into conversational quality, scientific rigor, and structural efficiency. We also introduce SciQuality, a pairwise evaluation of multi-turn research conversations grounded in 300 held-out scientific papers and scored on six dimensions: methodological soundness, justification, logical consistency, factual correctness, novelty, and responsiveness. Fine-tuned on 8.62K synthetic research conversations, CollabSciReM is preferred on SciQuality over a science-agnostic reward baseline trained on the same data for all four Llama and Qwen models, including a 65.3% win rate at matched response length. For the 7B and 8B models, CollabSciReM outperforms the science-agnostic reward baseline on the primary metric in 8 of 10 single- and multi-turn benchmark settings. In a blind study, domain experts rated CollabSciReM significantly higher on novelty than the general-reward variant and reported fewer hallucinated responses than both the general-reward variant and the base model.
articles.titleCn: CollabSciReM：通过科学感知奖励分解对齐语言模型以进行科学对话
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用作研究合作者，在多轮交互中协助假设完善、方法论规划和技术分析。在这种背景下，一个有用的助手必须准确、方法上合理、逻辑一致且高效利用token。当前的模型对齐方法很少能同时实现这些目标。指令微调模型通过冗长性获得对话质量，而我们表明，面向科学的通用协作奖励是以牺牲科学严谨性为代价来压缩响应的。我们提出了CollabSciReM，这是一个目标条件奖励框架，将会话级别的奖励分解为对话质量、科学严谨性和结构效率。我们还引入了SciQuality，这是一种基于300篇留存科学论文、在六个维度上评分的成对评估方法，这六个维度是：方法论合理性、论证、逻辑一致性、事实准确性、新颖性和响应性。在8.62K个合成研究对话上进行微调后，CollabSciReM在SciQuality评估中优于在相同数据上训练的面向科学的通用奖励基线，包括在匹配响应长度的情况下以65.3%的胜率优于所有四个Llama和Qwen模型。对于7B和8B模型，CollabSciReM在10个单轮和多轮基准设置中的8个主要指标上优于面向科学的奖励基线。在一项盲法研究中，领域专家在创新性方面显著评高了CollabSciReM，并报告其比通用奖励变体和基础模型产生的幻觉响应更少。

articles.title: Testing Associative Creativity in Humans and Multimodal LLMs with Difficult-to-Name Visual Stimuli
articles.abstract: We investigate associative creativity in descriptions of abstract visual stimuli by humans and multimodal large language models (MLLMs). While conceptual association is central to human communication, it remains unclear how humans and models adapt when visual stimuli become increasingly difficult to map onto familiar semantic concepts. We evaluate several state-of-the-art MLLMs and human participants along two dimensions of creativity, originality and effectiveness, using two datasets with controlled manipulations of difficulty. SilCC varies naming difficulty through progressively more complex combinations of abstract shapes, and PixCC varies difficulty through increasing levels of random visual noise. Results show that humans produce more diverse associative descriptions than MLLMs, including greater semantic distance, higher entropy, and more novel expressions relative to reference lexica. As difficulty increases, effectiveness declines in SilCC, and humans increasingly shift from holistic associations to descriptions of low-level visual properties in PixCC.
articles.titleCn: 使用难以命名的视觉刺激测试人类和多模态大语言模型中的联想创造力
articles.abstractCn: 我们通过人类和多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）对抽象视觉刺激的描述中的联想创造力进行了研究。虽然概念联想是人类交流的核心，但人类和模型在视觉刺激越来越难以映射到熟悉的语义概念时如何适应仍不清楚。我们使用两个具有难度控制的数据库，沿创造力的两个维度——原创性和有效性——评估了数个最先进的MLLM和人类参与者。SilCC通过抽象形状的复杂组合逐渐变化命名难度，而PixCC通过增加随机视觉噪声水平来变化难度。结果表明，人类产生的联想描述比MLLM更多样化，包括更大的语义距离、更高的熵以及相对于参考词汇库更多的新颖表达。随着难度的增加，SilCC中的有效性下降，PixCC中人类越来越倾向于从整体联想转向对低级视觉属性的描述。

articles.title: From Tokens to Files: Multi-Granularity Detection and Localization of AI-Involved Code
articles.abstract: The increasing use of large language models for code generation calls for methods that distinguish purely human-written code from AI-involved code: files in which any part, however small, was generated or substantially modified by a model. Beyond flagging such files, we aim to localize the lines or blocks attributable to AI. Existing approaches compress a file into a single score, from surface stylistic features or a global code representation, which averages away the evidence when only a few blocks are AI-involved. We propose a framework that models AI authorship at the token level and predicts at the line, block, and file levels. A frozen code language model is equipped with two low-rank adapters, trained separately on machine-written and human-written files; their per-token log-likelihood ratio provides local evidence of AI authorship. Lightweight heads aggregate this evidence within lines and blocks, using the surrounding code context, and their local predictions are aggregated into a file-level decision. We train on mixed-authorship files built from human originals and their AI-generated or AI-modified counterparts, including continuation and fill-in-the-middle scenarios. On an internal test set of 11,773 AI-involved files across six generation regimes against 2,541 human files, our method reaches 72.4 macro F1 at a 1% FPR operating point. With no adaptation, it reaches 62.5 line-level F1 on HybridCodeAuthorship, an external human-AI co-writing benchmark with no training split, above the 56 its own paper reports as the best line-level result. On 19,445 human-written files from repositories created before 2022, the false-positive rate stays between 0.55% and 0.81% under the transported 1% threshold, so the operating point holds on real human code.
articles.titleCn: 从令牌到文件：涉及人工智能的代码的多粒度检测与定位
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在代码生成中的日益广泛使用，要求开发能够区分纯人类编写代码与涉及人工智能代码的方法：即任何部分，无论多么微小，都由模型生成或大幅修改的文件。除了标记此类文件外，我们的目标是将可归因于人工智能的行或代码块定位。现有方法将文件压缩成一个单一的分数，基于表面风格特征或全局代码表示，当只有少数代码块涉及人工智能时，这种方法会平均掉证据。我们提出一个框架，在标记级别对人工智能作者身份进行建模，并在行、块和文件级别进行预测。一个冻结的代码语言模型配备了两个低秩适配器，分别在不同时训练于机器编写和人类编写的文件上；它们的每个标记的对数似然比提供了人工智能作者身份的局部证据。轻量级头部利用周围的代码上下文，在行和块内聚合这种证据，它们的局部预测被聚合为文件级别的决策。我们在由人类原始文件及其人工智能生成或人工智能修改的对应文件构建的混合作者身份文件上训练，包括续写和中间填充场景。在一个包含六种生成模式下的11,773个涉及人工智能的文件和2,541个人类文件的内部测试集中，我们的方法在1% FPR操作点下达到了72.4的宏观F1。未经调整，它在没有训练分割的HybridCodeAuthorship外部人类-人工智能共同写作基准上达到了62.5的行级F1，高于其论文报告的最佳行级结果56。在2022年前创建的19,445个人类编写文件中，在传输的1%阈值下，误报率保持在0.55%到0.81%之间，因此操作点适用于真实人类代码。

articles.title: UvA-MT's Participation in the WMT26 General Translation Shared Task
articles.abstract: This paper presents UvA-MT's submission to the WMT 2026 General Machine Translation shared task, competing in the unconstrained track across all 23 translation directions. This year, we fully leverage the test-time methods of Large Language Models (LLMs) for machine translation. Specifically, (1) we use sequential sampling with a refinement prompt to generate a pool of translation candidates for each source segment, a strategy shown to outperform traditional parallel sampling; and (2) we employ LLMs as pairwise judges to select the best candidate via a round-robin voting mechanism, with offline evaluation on the WMT25 benchmark showing a very clear improvement over point-wise best-of-N selection. Combined, these two strategies form our WMT26 submission.
articles.titleCn: 乌得勒支大学-MT在WMT26通用翻译共享任务中的参与
articles.abstractCn: 本文介绍了UvA-MT团队提交的WMT 2026通用机器翻译共享任务的参赛作品，参赛项目涵盖了全部23个翻译方向的无约束赛道。今年，我们充分利用大型语言模型（LLM）的测试时方法进行机器翻译。具体而言，(1)我们采用带细化提示的顺序采样方法为每个源段落生成一组翻译候选，该策略被证明优于传统的并行采样；以及(2)我们运用LLM作为成对评委，通过循环投票机制选择最佳候选，WMT25基准测试的离线评估显示，该方法相较于逐点最佳N选策略取得了非常显著的改进。这两项策略共同构成了我们的WMT26提交方案。

articles.title: SciDiagBench: A Type-Specific Benchmark for Human-Aligned Evaluation of Scientific Diagrams
articles.abstract: Recent agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in generating images from textual prompts, motivating their utilization for scientific diagram generation. Scientific diagrams naturally span diverse types, each characterized by distinct visual structures and content organization. Consequently, during peer review and other scientific evaluation, human experts naturally consider type-specific criteria when assessing their quality. However, existing VLM-based evaluation benchmarks fail to reflect the above human evaluation practices for two main reasons: 1) benchmark datasets typically lack a systematic categorization of different diagram types and thus adopt the same generic criteria for all diagrams, and 2) their evaluation criteria are often designed heuristically, without explicit alignment to human evaluation preferences. Motivated by these limitations, we introduce SciDiagBench, which consists of a benchmark dataset that systematically categorizes scientific diagrams into 11 types and a human preference-guided evaluation method. Specifically, SciDiagBench contains 165 scientific diagrams across 10 broad domains, with types including graphical abstracts, technical roadmaps, and illustrative cases. Based on this dataset, SciDiagBench develops an evaluation method that leverages a preference-guided calibration process to incorporate human preferences into the generation of type-specific criteria. Ultimately, SciDiagBench enables more reliable automated evaluation that better aligns with human evaluation across diverse scientific diagrams.
articles.titleCn: SciDiagBench：一种针对特定类型的科学图表人类对齐评估基准
articles.abstractCn: 近期代理在根据文本提示生成图像方面展现出强大能力，这促使人们将其应用于科学图表生成。科学图表自然涵盖多种类型，每种类型都具有独特的视觉结构和内容组织方式。因此，在同行评审和其他科学评估过程中，人类专家在评估其质量时自然会考虑类型特定的标准。然而，现有的基于视觉语言模型的评估基准未能反映上述人类评估实践，主要原因有两个：1）基准数据集通常缺乏对不同图表类型的系统分类，因此对所有图表采用相同的通用标准，2）它们的评估标准通常是启发式设计的，没有与人类评估偏好明确对齐。受这些限制的启发，我们引入了SciDiagBench，它包含一个基准数据集，该数据集系统地分类科学图表为11种类型，以及一个以人类偏好为导向的评估方法。具体而言，SciDiagBench包含10个广泛领域的165个科学图表，类型包括图形摘要、技术路线图和说明性案例。基于此数据集，SciDiagBench开发了一种评估方法，该方法利用偏好引导校准过程将人类偏好融入类型特定标准的生成中。最终，SciDiagBench实现了更可靠的自动评估，更好地与不同科学图表的人类评估对齐。

articles.title: SMART: Semantic Segment Mapping and Assessment of Recognition Transcripts with Contextual Rubrics
articles.abstract: Word error rate (WER) assigns equal cost to lexical edits despite their different semantic consequences, while overall semantic scores cannot identify which individual errors alter the intended meaning. We formulate ASR semantic evaluation as context-aware, segment-level consequence assessment and propose Semantic Segment Mapping and Assessment of Recognition Transcripts with Contextual Rubrics (SMART), a framework for traceable semantic evaluation and targeted ASR correction. SMART maps reference-hypothesis discrepancies into coherent segments and applies a structured contextual rubric to assign explicit consequence labels. These labels support Semantic Impact Error Rate (SIER), which quantifies consequential errors at utterance, chunk, and lexical levels. Against majority-vote human labels, SMART achieves 0.843 F1 versus 0.745 for direct LLM judgment. Evaluation across multiple LLMs further demonstrates that SMART is relatively insensitive to the choice of evaluation model, while MER and SIER reveal different aspects of ASR quality. A separate target-reference-free rubric guides correction using the target hypothesis and surrounding ASR hypotheses, outperforming a matched w/o Rubric baseline on both datasets, with further absolute reductions of 0.85-0.98 percentage points in MER and 1.18-1.65 percentage points in SIER_lex.
articles.titleCn: 基于上下文的语义分割映射与识别转录评估系统
articles.abstractCn: 词错误率（WER）对不同语义后果的词汇编辑赋予相同成本，而整体语义评分无法识别哪些个别错误改变了预期含义。我们将语音识别（ASR）语义评估形式化为上下文感知的、片段级别的后果评估，并提出语义片段映射与上下文评分识别转录（SMART）框架，该框架用于可追溯的语义评估和有针对性的ASR校正。SMART将参考-假设差异映射为连贯片段，并应用结构化的上下文评分标准分配明确的后果标签。这些标签支持语义影响错误率（SIER），该指标量化了在语句、片段和词汇层面的后果性错误。与多数投票人工标签相比，SMART的F1分数达到0.843，而直接大型语言模型（LLM）判断仅为0.745。跨多个LLM的评估进一步表明，SMART对评估模型的选择相对不敏感，而MER和SIER揭示了ASR质量的不同方面。一个独立的、无需目标-参考的评分标准使用目标假设和周围ASR假设进行校正，在两个数据集上均优于匹配无评分基线，并在MER上绝对减少了0.85-0.98个百分点，在SIER_lex上绝对减少了1.18-1.65个百分点。

articles.title: ProVe: Proposer-Verifier Decoding
articles.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive (AR) language models by letting a small model draft tokens serially and a large model verify them in parallel. We reverse these roles. Starting from a standard AR checkpoint, we fine-tune the large model into a proposer that predicts a block of future tokens in a single forward pass, then use one additional forward pass to verify the proposed block. This gives ProVe, Proposer-Verifier decoding. The verifier can be a smaller AR model or the proposer itself; the latter gives ProVe-lossless, which reproduces the proposer's greedy AR decoding. Block proposals already provide substantial room for acceleration: with a block size of 16, the proposed block has an average AR-matching prefix of 6.6 tokens on GSM8K. Across six benchmarks with a 32B proposer, ProVe-lossless reaches 2.5x average AR throughput without training a separate draft head. With a small 3B verifier, ProVe reaches 2.7x average throughput at 2.6 accuracy points below AR on the six-task average, providing a controllable tradeoff between speed and accuracy.
articles.titleCn: ProVe：提议者-验证者解码
articles.abstractCn: 推测解码通过让一个小模型串行生成token，再让一个大模型并行验证来加速自回归（AR）语言模型。我们反转了这些角色。从标准的AR检查点开始，我们将大模型微调成一个提议者，在单次前向传递中预测未来的一块token，然后使用一次额外的前向传递来验证提议的块。这给出了ProVe，即提议者-验证者解码。验证者可以是一个更小的AR模型或提议者本身；后者给出了ProVe无损，它再现了提议者的贪婪AR解码。块提议已经为加速提供了很大的空间：在GSM8K上，块大小为16时，提议的块平均AR匹配前缀为6.6个token。在六个基准测试中，使用32B的提议者，ProVe无损在不训练单独的草稿头的情况下达到了2.5倍的AR平均吞吐量。使用一个3B的小验证者，ProVe在六个任务平均上比AR低2.6个准确度点，达到了2.7倍的吞吐量，提供了速度和准确度之间的可控权衡。

articles.title: Are Linguistic and Arithmetic Circuits Dissociated in LLMs?
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit both knowledge of language, rendered by, for example, grammatical judgment ability, and abilities to perform tasks through language, such as math-word problem solving. Motivated by neurolinguistic studies of their neural dissociation in human brains, in this study, we investigate the overlap of their circuits in large language models (LLMs). Specifically, we examine the overlap and causal effects between the circuits extracted for linguistic and arithmetic tasks, using controlled materials and circuit discovery methods from the mechanistic interpretability field. Our experiments with five LLMs show that circuit similarity is mostly explained by task domains (linguistic vs. arithmetic), rather than by their input and output vocabularies or by the syntactic similarities between natural-language sentences and arithmetic expressions. This finding suggests that LLMs may process linguistic and arithmetic information using largely separate neural circuits, highlighting an ability-based modular organization of circuits within these models.
articles.titleCn: 语言和算术电路在大型语言模型中是否分离？
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）既表现出语言知识，例如语法判断能力，也展现出通过语言执行任务的能力，如数学文字题求解。受神经语言学对其大脑神经分离现象研究的启发，本研究调查了大型语言模型（LLMs）中其神经回路的重叠情况。具体而言，我们利用机制可解释性领域的受控材料和回路发现方法，考察了用于语言和算术任务的回路之间的重叠和因果关系。我们对五个LLMs进行的实验表明，回路相似性主要是由任务领域（语言与算术）解释的，而非由它们的输入输出词汇表或自然语言句子与算术表达式之间的句法相似性解释。这一发现表明，LLMs可能使用基本分离的神经回路来处理语言和算术信息，突出了这些模型中回路基于能力模块化的组织能力。

articles.title: Give the Model a Finger: Developmentally Aligned Evaluation of Counting in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are exact on small sets and drift into estimation on larger ones, a profile reminiscent of children before they master counting. Children cross the barrier with epistemic actions: pointing at each item while reciting number words, moving counted items aside, partitioning the array. We give VLMs the same actions as dumb image tools with no visual intelligence of their own in a training-free agent loop. Our central claim is about measurement, not intervention: a model that counts by marking leaves a normally hidden serial procedure on the image, and the developmental principles of counting turn those marks into an interpretable audit of serial visual reasoning: every tag is classified against point-level ground truth as on-target, duplicate, phantom, or omitted, the answer is checked against the number of tags, and order irrelevance is tested by forcing opposite traversal orders. Across 9 models, 682 images, and 7 harness conditions we find that (i) the exact-counting range is a model-specific signature spanning nearly two orders of magnitude (R80 from 3 to 150 dots); (ii) as an intervention the finger mostly fails: tags help 4 of 9 models on small-count photographs, hurt imprecise pointers, and rarely beat a verbal routine or a blind point list; what the loop buys is an auditable trace, not accuracy; (iii) as measurement it succeeds: a tag-perturbation probe shows that precise pointers read their answers off the tags, pointing precision tracks which models benefit, dense scenes fail by omission, and models rarely revise after seeing their own tags; and (iv) the capacities dissociate: models follow an instructed traversal order yet often change their answer when it reverses, and children's regular-over-scattered advantage appears only under the routine and survives lattices that defeat a rows-times-columns shortcut.
articles.titleCn: 给模型一个手指：针对视觉-语言模型的计数发展性评估
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在小数据集上表现精确，而在大数据集上则逐渐偏离估计模式，这种特征让人联想到尚未掌握数数能力的儿童。儿童通过认知行为跨越这一障碍：边指着每个物品边念数字词，将已数过的物品移开，对物品进行分区。我们让VLMs在无自身视觉智能的、无需训练的代理循环中执行同样的行为。我们的核心主张是关于测量而非干预：通过标记进行计数的模型会在图像上留下一个通常被隐藏的序列过程，而计数的发育原理将这些标记转化为可解释的视觉推理审计：每个标签都相对于点级真实数据进行分类，分为命中、重复、虚幻或遗漏，答案会与标签数量进行核对，并通过强制相反的遍历顺序来测试顺序无关性。在9个模型、682张图像和7种测试条件下，我们发现：(i)精确计数范围是特定于模型的特征，跨越近两个数量级（R80从3到150个点）；(ii)作为干预，手指大多无效：标签在小型计数照片上帮助了9个模型中的4个，损害了不精确的指针，且很少优于口头程序或盲点列表；循环带来的不是准确性，而是可审计的痕迹；(iii)作为测量，它成功了：标签扰动探测表明精确指针从标签中读取答案，指向精度追踪了受益的模型，密集场景因遗漏而失败，且模型很少在看到自己的标签后进行修正；(iv)能力分离：模型遵循指令的遍历顺序，但当顺序反转时却经常改变答案，儿童在常规操作中的优势只在常规下出现，并能经受住破坏行乘列快捷方式的格网测试。

articles.title: Hearsay or Fact? How Framing and Elicitation Shape LLM Probability Updates
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judgment assistants and as stand-in participants in psychology experiments, yet little is known about how much their probability estimates move in response to a single new piece of information. We pair premise-hypothesis items from $δ$-SNLI with one strengthener and one weakener each, elicit the prior and the posteriors in separate calls, and measure the directional movement s: the mean posterior change signed by the annotated direction, so that the prior cancels out. We vary whether the update is stated ("Here is something else you learned") or reported ("Someone said that"), and whether the model gives one probability or five weighted estimates. We test seven configurations: two local models (Qwen3-8B, OLMo-2-7B; 240 pairs) and five configurations run through agent command-line harnesses (120 pairs), with hypotheses and analysis rules fixed before the formal runs (not publicly registered). Under stated, direct elicitation all seven move in the annotated direction (s = 18-28 percentage points). Reporting lowers s in all seven point estimates (significantly in six, by 2-5 points) and raises the share of reverse movements in all seven: the effect is consistent but small. Five weighted estimates lower the share of responses at $\leq$5% or $\geq$95% in all seven, but in the two local models they also reduce s by 43% and 68%, whereas in the harnessed configurations the point estimates of the change lie between -3.7 and +0.5 points. An elicitation format that reduces extreme values thus need not preserve sensitivity to evidence; the two should be tested separately. Because $δ$-NLI annotates only direction, we make no claim about how large an update should be. Code, data and the frozen plan: https://github.com/asj252/llm-judgment-studies
articles.comment: 27 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. v2 adds four model configurations (gpt-oss-120b, claude-sonnet-5.5, gemini-3.8-flash at two reasoning efforts) run with the same protocol, and an exploratory analysis of candidate spread. Code and data: https://github.com/asj252/llm-judgment-studies
articles.titleCn: 传闻还是事实？框架和提取如何影响大型语言模型的概率更新
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用作判断辅助工具和心理实验中的替代参与者，但对其在接收到单个新信息时概率估计的变化程度知之甚少。我们将δ-SNLI的命题-假设项目与每个项目配对一个强化者和一个弱化者，分别在单独的调用中获取先验概率和后验概率，并测量方向性变化s：即由标注方向签署的后验概率变化均值，以便消除先验概率的影响。我们变化更新的陈述方式（“这里有一些你学到的其他信息”）或报告方式（“有人说过那样的话”），以及模型是给出一个概率还是五个加权估计。我们测试了七种配置：两个本地模型（Qwen3-8B、OLMo-2-7B；240对）和五个通过代理命令行套件运行的配置（120对），在正式运行前固定了假设和分析规则（未公开注册）。在直接陈述的引导下，所有七种模型都朝标注方向移动（s = 18-28个百分点）。报告方式降低了所有七种点估计的s值（六种显著降低，降低2-5个百分点），并提高了所有七种模型中反向移动的比例：这种效应是一致的但较小。五个加权估计降低了所有七种模型中≤5%或≥95%的响应比例，但在两个本地模型中，它们还分别降低了s值43%和68%，而在套件配置中，变化值的点估计介于-3.7到+0.5个百分点之间。因此，减少极端值的引导格式不一定能保持对证据的敏感性；这两种特性应分别进行测试。由于δ-NLI仅标注方向，我们不对更新应有多大做出主张。代码、数据和冻结的计划：https://github.com/asj252/llm-judgment-studies

articles.title: Tracing Recurrent and Emergent Hallucination Patterns in Decomposed Text-to-SQL Generation
articles.abstract: Large language models can achieve strong Text-to-SQL benchmark performance while still producing schema and query-logic errors. Most evaluations characterize such failures only in the final generated query, making it difficult to determine whether a related error was also observed in an earlier, simpler step or appears only at the final stage. We present a drill-down evaluation framework that decomposes Text-to-SQL queries into progressively more complex executable sub-queries and corresponding natural-language questions, allowing rule-based hallucination categories to be examined across a generation path. We distinguish recurrent hallucinations, in which the same rule-based category is observed in an earlier step and again in the final query, from emergent hallucinations, in which the category is observed at the final step without an earlier detection in the same path. Across five LLMs evaluated on an expanded BIRD-mini benchmark, several categories show appreciable recurrence probabilities, while clause abuse shows comparatively higher conditional emergence. Under the conversational-history condition, recurrence probabilities are generally higher and emergence probabilities are generally lower. These observations indicate that the two conditional measures do not move uniformly in the same direction under additional context and motivate trajectory-level analysis in addition to final-output evaluation. Code and evaluation artifacts are available in the project repository. https://github.com/HaydenMM/bird-mini-drilldown
articles.comment: Accepted to the 3rd Workshop on Uncertainty-Aware NLP (UncertaiNLP 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: 追踪分解文本到SQL生成中的循环和涌现幻觉模式
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在实现强大的文本到SQL基准性能的同时，仍可能产生模式和查询逻辑错误。大多数评估仅以最终生成的查询来表征此类失败，这使得难以判断相关错误是否也出现在早期、更简单的步骤中，或者仅在最终阶段出现。我们提出了一种下钻评估框架，将文本到SQL查询分解为逐步更复杂的可执行子查询和相应的自然语言问题，从而允许在生成路径中检查基于规则的幻觉类别。我们将重复幻觉与涌现幻觉区分开来：重复幻觉是指在早期步骤和最终查询中观察到同一基于规则的类别，而涌现幻觉是指在最终步骤中观察到该类别，但在同一路径的早期步骤中没有检测到。在扩展的BIRD-mini基准上评估的五个LLM中，几个类别显示出显著的重复概率，而子句滥用则表现出相对较高的条件涌现。在对话历史条件下，重复概率通常更高，涌现概率通常更低。这些观察结果表明，在附加上下文中，两个条件度量并不总是同向变化，这促使我们在最终输出评估之外进行轨迹级分析。代码和评估工件可在项目存储库中获取。https://github.com/HaydenMM/bird-mini-drilldown

articles.title: When Does Experience Memory Help Closed-Loop LLM Driving Agents? A Controlled Evaluation with Resampled Warmup Pools, Token-Matched Fillers, and Audited Baselines
articles.abstract: When does experience memory help a closed-loop LLM driving agent? Published gains cannot say, because the two factors we find to matter most, which warmup experiences the pool contains and what any injected tokens do to the prompt, are controlled in none of them. We answer with a controlled evaluation on one audited HighwayEnv testbed (1Hz, gpt-4o-mini for the decisive contrasts). We treat the warmup pool as a resampled random factor (ten disjoint pools) and add token-matched irrelevant-filler controls, oracle-certified diagnostics, caution-pricing metrics, and quantified audits of the baseline ports. The probe suite spans flat-text retrieval (a DiLu port), a single-frame grid port (RESPOND-inspired), our episodic temporal-graph memory, a retrieval-free consolidated rulebook, and a flat K-step observation-history baseline. Four findings follow, each a property of this testbed. (1) Headline memory gains belong to the warmup draw. The reported pool is the best of ten for both retrieval memories, which beat No-Memory in only one pool of ten (sign test p=0.011), and even the rulebook's apparent pool-immunity collapsed on five fresh draws. (2) No retrieval design tested exceeds token-matched filler. The collision-only merge ceiling is reached by a single 15-token caution instruction, and metrics that price caution erase the rulebook's lead. (3) Representational sophistication is nowhere robustly operative. (4) Baseline port quality silently inverts conclusions. On this testbed, a single-pool comparison without filler controls would have reported memory gains that these controls reverse. We release the testbed, audited ports, seeds, and caches.
articles.titleCn: 经验记忆何时有助于闭环LLM驾驶代理？一项使用重采样预热池、标记匹配填充器和审核基线的控制评估
articles.abstractCn: 经验记忆何时有助于闭环LLM驾驶代理？已发布的收益无法说明，因为我们在研究中发现最重要的两个因素——预热经验池包含的内容以及注入的标记对提示的影响——在它们中均未被控制。我们通过在一个经过审计的高速公路环境测试平台（1Hz，使用gpt-4o-mini进行关键对比）上的受控评估来回答这个问题。我们将预热池视为一个重采样的随机因素（十个互斥的池），并添加了标记匹配的无关填充控制、神谕认证的诊断、谨慎定价指标以及对基线端口的量化审计。探测套件包括平面文本检索（一个DiLu端口）、单帧网格端口（受RESPOND启发）、我们的情景时序图记忆、无检索的整合规则簿以及平面K步观察历史基线。由此得出四个发现，每个发现都是该测试平台的一个特性。（1）标题记忆收益属于预热抽取。报告的池是十个池中最好的，对于两种检索记忆，它只在十个池中的一个中优于无记忆，即使规则簿的明显池免疫性在五个新的抽取中也崩溃了。（2）没有测试的检索设计超过标记匹配填充。只有碰撞合并的上限由一个15标记的谨慎指令达到，而定价谨慎的指标消除了规则簿的领先地位。（3）表征的复杂性在何处都没有稳健地运作。（4）基线端口质量无声地反转了结论。在这个测试平台上，如果没有填充控制的单池比较将报告记忆收益，而这些控制会反转这些收益。我们发布了测试平台、经过审计的端口、种子和缓存。

articles.title: Beyond Calibration: Temporal LLM Confidence Assessment Across Languages and Local Settings
articles.abstract: Large language models are expected to estimate their own uncertainty, with confidence signals used to guide retrieval, adaptive compute allocation, routing, and selective abstention. We investigate whether confidence signals measured at different temporal stages of problem solving encode distinct forms of epistemic information and remain reliable beyond English-centric settings. Inspired by classical meta-memory theory, we distinguish anticipatory pre-solve confidence (Feeling-of-Knowing, FOK) from retrospective post-solve confidence (Judgement-of-Learning, JOL). We evaluate these signals across two frontier LLMs, multiple reasoning domains, translated Marathi benchmarks, and a newly constructed benchmark of genuinely local Marathi factual questions. Across settings, the cheaper pre-solve signal remains weakly calibrated, while post-solve confidence generally provides stronger epistemic alignment despite its additional inference cost. Confidence behaviour transfers surprisingly well under direct language translation, with calibration trends largely preserved between English and Marathi, but degrades substantially on local Marathi knowledge, suggesting that linguistic transfer alone is insufficient for region-specific information needs. Finally, hallucinated responses maintain persistently elevated confidence after answer generation, highlighting important limitations of current LLM self-assessment mechanisms.
articles.titleCn: 超越校准：跨语言和本地环境的时序LLM置信度评估
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型被期望能够评估自身的不确定性，置信信号用于指导检索、自适应计算分配、路由和选择性放弃。我们研究了在不同问题解决时间阶段测量的置信信号是否编码了不同形式的认知信息，并且是否在以英语为中心的设置之外仍然可靠。受经典元记忆理论的启发，我们将预期性预解决置信（知晓感，FOK）与回顾性后解决置信（学习判断，JOL）区分开来。我们在两个前沿大型语言模型、多个推理领域、翻译的马拉地基准以及一个新构建的真正本地马拉地事实性问题基准上评估了这些信号。在所有设置中，较便宜的预解决信号仍然弱校准，而后解决置信尽管增加了推理成本，通常提供了更强的认知一致性。置信行为在直接语言翻译下转移得相当好，英语和马拉地之间的校准趋势基本保持一致，但在本地马拉地知识上大幅下降，表明仅靠语言迁移不足以满足区域特定的信息需求。最后，幻觉响应在生成答案后仍然保持持续升高的置信度，突出了当前大型语言模型自我评估机制的重要局限性。

articles.title: Memory as Code: Declarative Retrieval over Codified Long-Term Memory
articles.abstract: In long-term memory systems, memories are constructed from interaction histories and retrieved in response to queries, enhancing the reasoning ability of LLM agents. In complex scenarios, facts are scattered across sessions and their relationships evolve over time, making it difficult for existing memory systems to compose them to adapt to diverse queries. Motivated by the modularity and composability of code, we propose Memory as Code (MaC), a unified memory framework that jointly designs memory construction and retrieval through a shared code abstraction. MaC couples codified construction, which establishes executable memory abstractions, with declarative retrieval, which translates queries into structured retrieval programs. Specifically, codified construction builds a three-layer executable memory structure that progresses from an atomic function layer, through a relational layer, to a modular composition layer. Declarative retrieval recasts retrieval from relevance-based fact selection into declarative query processing over memory. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show relative gains of up to 15.91% in overall LLM-judge accuracy over the strongest baseline in each setting, while substantially reducing token consumption, highlighting the effectiveness of memory as code for long-horizon memory tasks.
articles.titleCn: 记忆即代码：对编码长期记忆的声明式检索
articles.abstractCn: 在长期记忆系统中，记忆是通过交互历史构建的，并根据查询进行检索，从而增强大型语言模型代理的推理能力。在复杂场景中，事实分散在不同的会话中，并且它们之间的关系随着时间的推移而演变，这使得现有的记忆系统难以将它们组合起来以适应各种查询。受代码模块化和可组合性的启发，我们提出了记忆即代码（MaC）这一统一的记忆框架，通过共享的代码抽象联合设计记忆的构建和检索。MaC将编码化的构建（建立可执行的记忆抽象）与声明式的检索（将查询转换为结构化的检索程序）相结合。具体而言，编码化的构建构建了一个三层可执行记忆结构，从原子函数层开始，经过关系层，最终到达模块化组合层。声明式的检索将检索从基于相关性的事实选择重新定义为对记忆的声明式查询处理。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验表明，在每种设置中最强的基线中，整体LLM-裁判准确率相对提高了15.91%，同时显著减少了token消耗，突出了记忆即代码在长期记忆任务中的有效性。

articles.title: PhonoBridge: Error-Aware Phoneme-Mediated EMG-to-Text Reconstruction
articles.abstract: Electromyography (EMG) provides a non-invasive means of decoding silently articulated speech into text, but accurate decoding remains challenging due to limited availability of paired EMG-text data. We introduce PhonoBridge, a two-stage framework comprising a channel-aware EMG-to-phoneme frontend and a large language model (LLM) backend for text reconstruction. The frontend is trained on paired EMG-text data that consists of channel-wise feature extraction, cross-channel fusion, and electrode embeddings. With phonemes as the intermediate representation, we expand the backend's training data by converting LibriSpeech transcripts into phoneme-text pairs without additional EMG recordings. To adapt the LLM to frontend noise, we introduce Error-Profile-Guided Augmentation (EPGA), which perturbs transcript-derived phoneme sequences according to error patterns estimated from frontend predictions, generating additional training pairs for the LLM. On the Open Vocabulary silent-speech dataset, PhonoBridge achieves 24.77% WER, outperforming the previously reported best of 28.27% on the same test split.
articles.titleCn: PhonoBridge：具有错误感知的音素介导的肌电图到文本重建
articles.abstractCn: 肌电图（EMG）提供了一种非侵入性的方法，将无声语言转化为文本，但由于EMG-文本配对数据的有限性，准确转化仍然具有挑战性。我们介绍了PhonoBridge，这是一个包含通道感知的EMG-音素前端和大型语言模型（LLM）后端的两阶段框架，用于文本重建。前端在EMG-文本配对数据上进行训练，该数据包含通道特征提取、跨通道融合和电极嵌入。以音素作为中间表示，我们通过将LibriSpeech文本转录转换为音素-文本对来扩展后端的训练数据，而无需额外的EMG记录。为了使LLM适应前端噪声，我们引入了误差特征引导增强（EPGA），该技术根据前端预测估计的误差模式扰动转录生成的音素序列，为LLM生成额外的训练对。在开放词汇无声语言数据集上，PhonoBridge实现了24.77%的WER，优于先前在同一测试划分中报道的最佳28.27%。

articles.title: CovNav: Conformal Prediction-Guided Adaptive Inference for Object Goal Navigation
articles.abstract: In object goal navigation (ObjectNav), an embodied agent must find a target object (e.g., "find a bed") in a previously unseen environment, relying on spatial commonsense such as object co-occurrence. Large Language Models (LLMs) encode this commonsense, but deploying them on robots exposes a trade-off between reasoning quality and efficiency: cloud-based models incur latency and privacy risks, whereas small on-device LLMs are fast but prone to hallucinated spatial judgments. Hybrid reasoning LLMs offer both a fast non-thinking mode and a slow thinking mode, which raises a key question for embodied agents: when is slow thinking worth its cost? We propose CovNav, a training-free framework that answers this question with Conformal Prediction (CP), turning dual-process (System 1 / System 2) inference into an uncertainty-aware decision. Much like recent decision models such as Jev, CovNav casts each spatial query as a structured binary decision rather than free-form generation: a local LLM in fast mode judges whether the target is likely near an observed object, CP converts its token probabilities into a prediction set, and only ambiguous queries are escalated to slow chain-of-thought reasoning. The object-pair formulation keeps calibration tractable and supports open-set objects through off-the-shelf detectors. Experiments on Gibson and HM3D show that CovNav surpasses the strongest zero-shot baseline by 0.8 and 1.7 percentage points in success rate on HM3D v1 and v2, while invoking slow reasoning for only 12.4% of queries and retaining most of the gain of always-on thinking at a fraction of its latency. Real-robot experiments on a TurtleBot 4 further validate the approach. CovNav shows how calibrated uncertainty can decide when an embodied agent should think slowly, offering a principled form of adaptive test-time reasoning for LLM-based robots.
articles.titleCn: CovNav：基于一致性预测引导的自适应推理的物体目标导航
articles.abstractCn: 在物体目标导航（ObjectNav）任务中，具身智能体需要在先前未见过的环境中寻找目标物体（例如，“找到一张床”），并依赖空间常识（如物体共现规律）。大型语言模型（LLMs）编码了这些常识，但将其部署在机器人上需要在推理质量和效率之间进行权衡：基于云的模型会产生延迟和隐私风险，而小型的边缘设备LLMs虽然快速但容易产生幻觉性的空间判断。混合推理LLMs同时提供了快速非思考模式和慢速思考模式，这为具身智能体提出了一个关键问题：何时慢速思考的成本是值得的？我们提出了CovNav，这是一个无需训练的框架，它通过一致性预测（CP）来回答这个问题，将双过程（系统1/系统2）推理转化为不确定性感知决策。与最近的决策模型（如Jev）类似，CovNav将每个空间查询视为结构化的二元决策，而不是自由形式的生成：本地LLM在快速模式下判断目标是否可能靠近观察到的物体，CP将其标记概率转换为预测集，只有模糊的查询才会升级到慢速思维链推理。物体对表述使校准过程保持可控，并通过现成的检测器支持开放集物体。在Gibson和HM3D上的实验表明，CovNav在HM3D v1和v2上的成功率分别比最强的零样本基线提高了0.8和1.7个百分点，同时仅12.4%的查询会调用慢速推理，并保留了大部分始终思考模式的增益，但延迟却只有其一部分。在TurtleBot 4上的真实机器人实验进一步验证了该方法。CovNav展示了如何通过校准的不确定性来决定具身智能体何时应进行慢速思考，为基于LLM的机器人提供了一种原则性的自适应测试时推理形式。

articles.title: Corpus Quality Improves, Retrieval Utility Does Not: An Ablation of Preprocessing and Refinement in a Speech-to-QA Pipeline
articles.abstract: Practitioners building training corpora with a pipeline of language models keep a preprocessing or refinement (post-process) stage when switching it on raises the corpus quality. We ablate a production pipeline that turns conference speech into question-answer pairs. The preprocessing stage rewrites the transcript, and the refinement stage filters the generated pairs. Switching each on and off gives four corpora from the same 40 Korean medical and finance sessions. On the corpus itself, quality rises as the stages switch on. Four LLM judges and six human domain experts rank the four corpora the same way, and the fully refined corpus leads by +0.18 and +0.22 on a 1-5 scale. We then ask whether that gain carries downstream. We supply each corpus to six models at inference and measure retrieval accuracy. The ranking does not hold. Enabling the transcript rewrite lowers retrieval accuracy by 0.061, the only stage effect that survives correction for multiple comparisons. That stage also reads the whole session, so it almost doubles the cost of one. With both stages on, accuracy does not change. An equivalence test we declared in advance confirms this. The corpus itself is clearly valuable. It lifts retrieval accuracy from 0.231 to 0.748 in every model and domain we test. More than a third of its pairs carry knowledge that neither of two frontier models produces on its own. On our data, the null does not come from weak corpora. A rising score on a rubric of this kind did not predict what the corpus holds for a model.
articles.comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/wonsupshin-flitto/speech-corpus-ablation
articles.titleCn: 语料库质量提升，检索效用未变：语音到问答流程中预处理与精炼的消融研究
articles.abstractCn: 使用语言模型流水线构建训练语料库的从业者会在开启预处理或精炼（后处理）阶段时，保持语料库质量。我们消融了一个将会议发言转换为问答对的生产流水线。预处理阶段重写发言稿，精炼阶段过滤生成的对。分别开启和关闭每个阶段，从相同的40个韩语医疗和金融会议中生成四个语料库。在语料库本身上，随着阶段依次开启，质量不断提高。四个大型语言模型（LLM）裁判和六个人类领域专家以相同方式对四个语料库进行排名，完全精炼的语料库在1-5分制上领先+0.18和+0.22。然后我们询问这种提升是否具有下游效应。我们将每个语料库提供给六个模型进行推理，并测量检索准确率。排名不再成立。启用发言稿重写会降低检索准确率0.061，这是唯一在多重比较校正后仍然存在的阶段效应。该阶段还会读取整个会议，因此几乎将成本翻倍。同时开启两个阶段时，准确率没有变化。我们预先宣布的等价性检验证实了这一点。语料库本身显然具有重要价值。在所有我们测试的模型和领域，它将检索准确率从0.231提升到0.748。其超过三分之一的对包含了两个前沿模型单独无法产生的知识。在我们的数据中，零假设并非来自薄弱语料库。在类似评分标准上的分数上升，并不能预测语料库对模型的价值。

articles.title: Speak vs. Know: Balancing Behavior and Knowledge Distributions of Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Recent work reports that the distribution verbalized directly in the output text aligns far better with human opinion distributions than the next-token log-probability distribution of LLMs. However, the verbalized distribution reflects what LLMs know about a group's opinions (knowledge distribution), while what they actually output at deployment is governed by their log-probability distribution (behavior distribution). We find that when prompting LLMs to predict the opinion of a specific group, the most likely answer under the verbalized distribution differs from that under the log-probability distribution for 37% of World Values Survey questions, averaged over three LLMs. Thus, LLMs' knowledge does not match their behavior. This matters for evaluation: a verbalized distribution can score well against a group while its most likely answer is one the model never outputs, so the score no longer describes the model. The alignment scores for these two distributions reflect only the model's behavior or its knowledge, separately. We therefore propose a learnable combination of the two distributions that follows the most likely answer of the behavior distribution while preserving the shape of the knowledge distribution, with a single hyperparameter trading off behavioral fidelity against distribution quality. Our experiments on three opinion survey datasets and six models show that the balanced distribution improves behavioral consistency over the verbalized distribution from 71.6% to 95.6% on average, while the total variation distance to the human opinion distributions rises only slightly from 28.8% to 33.8%, and it remains effective under temperature scaling and cross-dataset settings.
articles.titleCn: 说与知：平衡大型语言模型的行为与知识分布
articles.abstractCn: 近期研究表明，直接在输出文本中表达的分布与人类意见分布的吻合程度远好于大型语言模型（LLM）的下一个词对数概率分布。然而，表达的分布反映了LLM对群体意见的了解（知识分布），而它们在实际部署中输出的内容则受其对数概率分布（行为分布）的支配。我们发现，当提示LLM预测特定群体的意见时，在表达分布下最可能的答案与在对数概率分布下最可能的答案在37%的世界价值观调查问题中存在差异，平均值为三个LLM。因此，LLM的知识与其行为并不匹配。这对评估至关重要：一个表达的分布可能对某个群体评分很高，但其最可能的答案却是模型从未输出的，因此该评分不再能描述模型。这两种分布的吻合度得分分别反映了模型的行为或其知识。因此，我们提出了一种可学习的两种分布的组合方法，该方法遵循行为分布的最可能答案，同时保留知识分布的形状，并使用一个超参数在行为保真度与分布质量之间进行权衡。我们在三个意见调查数据集和六个模型上的实验表明，平衡分布平均将行为一致性从71.6%提高到95.6%，而与人类意见分布的总变差距离仅从28.8%略微增加到33.8%，并且在温度缩放和跨数据集设置下仍然有效。

articles.title: CUA-Recovery: Benchmarking Error Recovery in Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents
articles.abstract: As computer-use agents (CUAs) move to long-horizon workflows spanning multiple applications, undetected errors can silently corrupt persistent state and cause cascading failures in subsequent actions. Reliable error detection and recovery have become critical bottlenecks for building robust CUAs. However, existing benchmarks focus primarily on end-to-end task performance, providing limited insight into whether agents can detect and recover from errors during execution. The few benchmarks that evaluate recovery rely largely on manually injected errors, which may not reflect the types or horizons of failures induced by real agent policies. We introduce CUA-Recovery, a benchmark comprising test and training suites across multiple desktop applications. We construct it using ReRail, a framework for synthesizing long-horizon tasks and trajectories in a persistent desktop environment. ReRail composes MyPCBench tasks into new long-horizon workflows with executable ground truth, collects verifier-confirmed failures from multiple policies, and turns them into verified recovery trajectories. CUA-Recovery comprises a human-verified test suite of 2,250 erroneous states over 100 tasks and a training suite of 8.6K trajectories over 377 tasks. Evaluation on the test suite shows that agents struggle both to recognize inherited errors and to complete the task. Across six agents and six takeover depths, Error Awareness Rate (EAR) reaches at most 44.0% and Pass@3 at most 25.5%. After fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on the training suite, its average EAR rises from 19.9% to 35.2% on held-out recovery states, and its Rubric Score goes from 5.0% to 16.1%. It also gains 15.3 points on MyPCBench and 10.8 points on Odysseys for Pass@3, showing that the training trajectories help both with recovery and with completing tasks from a clean start. Our code is available at https://github.com/xu-hu-2002/CUA-Recovery.
articles.titleCn: CUA-Recovery：长时程计算机使用代理的错误恢复基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 随着计算机使用代理（CUAs）转向跨越多个应用程序的长期工作流程，未被检测到的错误可能会无声地破坏持久状态，并在后续操作中引发级联故障。可靠的错误检测和恢复已成为构建鲁棒CUAs的关键瓶颈。然而，现有的基准主要关注端到端任务性能，对代理能否在执行过程中检测和恢复错误提供了有限的洞察。少数评估恢复的基准主要依赖手动注入的错误，这些错误可能无法反映真实代理策略诱导的故障类型或范围。我们引入了CUA-Recovery，这是一个包含多个桌面应用程序测试和训练套件的基准。我们使用ReRail框架构建它，ReRail是一个用于在持久桌面环境中合成长期任务和轨迹的框架。ReRail将MyPCBench任务组合成新的长期工作流程，具有可执行的ground truth，从多个策略中收集验证器确认的失败，并将它们转化为经过验证的恢复轨迹。CUA-Recovery包含一个包含100个任务和2,250个经过人工验证的错误状态的测试套件，以及一个包含377个任务和8.6K个轨迹的训练套件。在测试套件上的评估表明，代理在识别继承的错误和完成任务方面都存在困难。在六个代理和六个接管深度下，错误意识率（EAR）最高达到44.0%，Pass@3最高达到25.5%。在训练套件上对Qwen3.5-35B-A3B进行微调后，其在保留的恢复状态上的平均EAR从19.9%提高到35.2%，其评分从5.0%提高到16.1%。它还在MyPCBench上提高了15.3分，在Odysseys上提高了10.8分，Pass@3表明训练轨迹不仅有助于恢复，还有助于从头开始完成任务。我们的代码可在https://github.com/xu-hu-2002/CUA-Recovery获取。

articles.title: BCT: Bayes-Consistent Tempering for Flow Language Models
articles.abstract: Temperature scaling is typically applied as a post-hoc transformation of model probabilities. In posterior-induced flow language models, this creates two mismatches. First, posterior tempering implicitly changes both the endpoint distribution and the distribution of intermediate noisy states, while the denoiser remains trained on the original states. Second, the tempered posterior weights are combined with transport dynamics derived for the untempered flow. These mismatches are reflected empirically: lowering temperature improves GSM8K performance much less reliably in flow LMs than in discrete diffusion LMs. We introduce Bayes-Consistent Tempering (BCT), which makes temperature explicit in both the distributions and dynamics of the generative flow. Its learned realization trains the denoiser on tempered intermediate states and tempers the endpoint distribution using the corresponding tempered dynamics. We also derive training-free variants for conventionally trained checkpoints. Across hyperspherical flow LMs with two denoiser architectures and a von Mises--Fisher flow LM, BCT improves GSM8K generation across broad temperature ranges and achieves the strongest tempering performance. The gains also extend to Sudoku, demonstrating benefits on tightly constrained generation. At very low temperatures, the learned realization is also markedly more robust than the training-free variants, supporting temperature as a property of the generative flow across training and inference rather than a post-hoc probability adjustment. Code and model weights are available at https://daioba.github.io/bct .
articles.titleCn: BCT：流语言模型的贝叶斯一致性调温方法
articles.abstractCn: 温度缩放通常被用作模型概率的后处理变换。在后验诱导流语言模型中，这会造成两种不匹配。首先，后验温度调整会隐式地改变终点分布和中间噪声状态分布，而降噪器仍然在原始状态上进行训练。其次，温度调整后的后验权重与未调整的流推导出的传输动力学相结合。这些不匹配在实践中得到体现：降低温度在流语言模型中比在离散扩散语言模型中能更不可靠地提高GSM8K性能。我们引入了贝叶斯一致性温度调整（BCT），它使温度在生成流的分布和动力学中都变得明确。其学习实现方式是在温度调整的中间状态上训练降噪器，并使用相应的温度调整动力学来调整终点分布。我们还为传统训练的检查点推导了无训练变体。在具有两种降噪器架构的超球面流语言模型和冯·米塞斯-费希尔流语言模型中，BCT在广泛的温度范围内提高了GSM8K生成性能，并实现了最强的温度调整性能。这些改进也扩展到数独任务，证明了在严格约束生成上的优势。在非常低的温度下，学习实现也比无训练变体具有显著的鲁棒性，支持温度作为生成流在训练和推理中的属性，而不是后验概率调整。代码和模型权重可在https://daioba.github.io/bct获取。

articles.title: A Two-Way Street: Surveying the Interplay between Code-Mixing and Native Languages in Text and Speech
articles.abstract: Systems for code-mixed (CM) text and speech rarely start from scratch. CM data is scarce, so most work borrows from the languages being mixed, which we call native languages. This transfer can also run in reverse, when CM data is used to improve models for the native languages. Existing surveys focus on processing CM itself, and none brings the two directions together. This paper fills that gap with a systematic survey of transfer in both directions, across text and speech. We organise the surveyed work in a taxonomy of transfer direction, route and modality. Through this taxonomy, we find that most transfer runs from native languages into the CM setting. The reverse direction is younger, and in it code-switching mainly helps by aligning the two languages. Text and speech work share methods but rarely cite each other. On a shared speech benchmark, native data helps more than new architectures. These findings point to open challenges, such as how much native and CM data to mix in training, and how to evaluate CM text written in different scripts.
articles.titleCn: 双向街：调查文本和语音中代码混合与母语之间的相互作用
articles.abstractCn: 混合代码（CM）文本和语音系统很少从头开始开发。由于CM数据稀缺，大多数研究借鉴所混合的语言，我们称之为母语。这种迁移也可以反向进行，即使用CM数据来改进母语模型。现有综述主要关注CM本身的处理，但没有将两个方向结合起来。本文通过系统性地综述文本和语音双向迁移，填补了这一空白。我们对所调研的工作按迁移方向、路径和模态进行分类。通过这种分类，我们发现大多数迁移是从母语流向CM环境。反向方向相对较新，其中代码转换主要通过协调两种语言来发挥作用。文本和语音工作共享方法，但很少相互引用。在共享的语音基准上，母语数据比新架构的帮助更大。这些发现指出了开放性挑战，例如在训练中应混合多少母语和CM数据，以及如何评估使用不同脚本书写的CM文本。

articles.title: PAR: Progress-Aligned Recurrence for Length Generalization in State Tracking
articles.abstract: Looped language models can run more iterations at test time, but additional iterations need not help them solve longer problems. For sequential state tracking, final-answer supervision does not specify how far each iteration should advance, and repeated updates can change the scale of the recurrent state. We introduce \textbf{Progress-Aligned Recurrence (PAR)}, which trains the prediction at iteration $k$ to match the state after the first $k$ operations and rescales recurrent states to their first-iteration norms. On swap-$S_5$, a Qwen2.5-0.5B model trained on at most 32 moves achieves 95.5\% mean full-state accuracy at 512 moves, or $16\times$ the training length, compared with 55.7\% reported for RLT and 0.8\% for explicit chain of thought on the same backbone. Controlled $S_5$ ablations show that removing norm anchoring reduces the extrapolation factor from $16\times$ to below $2.2\times$, and replacing progress-aligned targets with final-answer supervision reduces it to at most $8\times$. A learned completion readout selects when to answer without a supplied stopping depth. When intermediate labels are unavailable, prefix self-distillation induces the correspondence from shorter problem prefixes using only final answers. The gains apply across sequential state-tracking tasks, establishing the task structure required for depth extrapolation. These findings support training intermediate predictions and state scale together to make additional recurrent depth useful for longer problems.
articles.titleCn: 状态跟踪中的长度泛化进度对齐递归
articles.abstractCn: 循环语言模型在测试时可以运行更多迭代，但额外的迭代并不一定能帮助它们解决更复杂的问题。对于顺序状态跟踪，最终答案的监督并不能指定每个迭代应该推进多远，重复的更新可能会改变循环状态的规模。我们引入了\textbf{进度对齐递归（PAR）}，该方法训练第$k$次迭代的预测以匹配前$k$次操作后的状态，并将循环状态重新缩放到其首次迭代的范数。在swap-$S_5$任务上，一个在最多32步上训练的Qwen2.5-0.5B模型在512步时达到了95.5%的平均全状态准确率，这是训练长度的16倍，而RLT报告的准确率为55.7%，显式思维链在相同主干网络上的准确率仅为0.8%。控制的$S_5$消融实验表明，移除范数锚定将外推因子从16倍降低到低于2.2倍，而用最终答案监督替换进度对齐目标将外推因子降低到最多8倍。一个学习的完成读出可以在没有提供的停止深度的情况下选择回答时间。当中间标签不可用时，前缀自蒸馏利用最终答案从较短的题目前缀中诱导对应关系。这些改进适用于所有顺序状态跟踪任务，确立了深度外推所需的任务结构。这些发现支持同时训练中间预测和状态规模，使额外的循环深度对更复杂的问题有用。

articles.title: ABench: Adversarily Benchmarking Large Language Models across Taxonomized Values
articles.abstract: Ensuring the alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) with diverse cultural values is critical for their safe global deployment. However, existing alignment benchmarks are predominantly English-centric or confined to simple discriminative tasks. Moreover, they often fail to effectively evaluate model robustness against complex, adversarial inductions within specific cultural contexts. To address these limitations, we propose ABench, a fine-grained, handcrafted benchmark specifically tailored to taxonomized values in Chinese. Grounded in a rigorous hierarchical taxonomy comprising 158 derived value subcategories, ABench consists of 2,895 open-ended questions. These questions employ techniques such as role-playing and logical traps to probe the stability of models' stances in adversarially induced contexts. Furthermore, we propose a weighted automated evaluation framework that utilizes question-specific scoring criteria for nuanced assessment. Extensive experiments on 16 mainstream LLMs reveal that most models exhibit significant vulnerabilities when subjected to sophisticated adversary attacks on values (scoring below 60). This underscores the need for more robust, culturally specific alignment strategies. Our data will be publicly released to promote further research on taxonomized value alignment.
articles.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 16 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables
articles.titleCn: ABench：跨分类值对大型语言模型进行对抗性基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 确保大型语言模型（LLMs）与多元文化价值观的协调对于其安全全球部署至关重要。然而，现有的协调基准主要集中于英语或局限于简单的判别任务。此外，它们通常无法有效评估模型在特定文化背景下针对复杂、对抗性诱导的鲁棒性。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了ABench，一个针对分类化价值观的细粒度、手工制作的基准，专门针对中文价值观。基于一个包含158个衍生价值观子类别的严格层次分类法，ABench包含2,895个开放式问题。这些问题采用角色扮演和逻辑陷阱等技术，以探究模型立场在对抗性诱导环境中的稳定性。此外，我们提出了一种加权自动化评估框架，利用特定问题的评分标准进行细致评估。在16个主流LLM上的大量实验表明，大多数模型在价值观上受到复杂对手攻击时表现出显著漏洞（得分低于60）。这凸显了需要更鲁棒、更具文化针对性的协调策略。我们的数据将公开发布，以促进分类化价值观协调的进一步研究。

articles.title: Auditing the Product, Not the Recursion: The Evaluation Evidence Behind Recursive Self-Improvement Claims
articles.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) promises AI systems, such as self-evolving LLM agents, that become better at producing further improvements. Evaluating this promise requires separating product claims about the final system from process claims about the improvement process itself. Existing surveys specify the evidence these claims require, but how often studies report that evidence remains unmeasured. We examine this question through full-text coding of 114 eligible studies in a reproducible arXiv search frame frozen in October 2026, including 90 that describe their own systems as RSI. The codebook links claims to evaluation designs. Independent human coding, third-reader adjudication, and a separate blind coding of improver comparisons assess coding reliability. Among the 90 RSI studies, 90% report product evaluation beyond development tasks under a broad criterion that includes partial or unstated separation, while 60% report evaluation on tasks unused for selection. Only 22% audit two or more reruns of the full loop. In a human-coded random sample, the RSI studies show the same contrast: 45% evaluate on tasks unused for selection and 14% audit two or more reruns. Of the 26 studies claiming a better improvement procedure, 23 report a related comparison, but only 4 compare earlier and later procedures from identical starting artifacts at a matched budget. Across these results and a comparison set of established works, evidence for repeatability and improved procedures remains less developed than product evaluation. Three propositions explain how selection effects, shared evaluator errors, and changes in system state limit what product evaluations can establish. Together, the findings support a claim-indexed reporting standard that connects each claim to the evaluation design needed to test it.
articles.titleCn: 审查产品而非递归：递归自我改进主张背后的评估证据
articles.abstractCn: 递归自我改进（RSI）承诺AI系统，例如自我进化的LLM代理，能够不断产生更好的改进。评估这一承诺需要将最终系统的产品声明与改进过程本身的流程声明区分开来。现有综述明确了这些声明所需的证据，但研究中有多少报告称证据仍未测量？我们通过对2026年10月冻结的可重复性arXiv搜索框架中114项合格研究的全文编码来考察这个问题，其中90项研究将其自身系统描述为RSI。编码簿将声明与评估设计联系起来。独立人工编码、第三方裁决以及改进者比较的单独盲编码评估了编码的可靠性。在90项RSI研究中，90%在广义标准下（包括部分或未明确分离）报告了超出开发任务的系统评估，而60%报告了在未用于选择任务上的评估。只有22%审计了完整循环的两次或更多次重跑。在人工编码的随机样本中，RSI研究显示出同样的对比：45%在未用于选择任务上进行评估，14%审计了两次或更多次重跑。在26项声称改进程序更好的研究中，23项报告了相关比较，但只有4项在匹配预算下比较了从相同初始工件开始的早期和后期程序。在这些结果与一组已建立作品比较中，可重复性和改进程序的证据不如产品评估发展得充分。三个命题解释了选择效应、共享评估者错误和系统状态变化如何限制产品评估所能确立的内容。这些发现共同支持了一种声明索引报告标准，该标准将每个声明与其所需的评估设计联系起来以测试它。

articles.title: Self-Decomposing Diffusion for Code Generation
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are emerging as a promising paradigm for code generation, offering the potential for fast, parallel decoding. However, generating complex programs remains challenging, as their interdependent components must maintain consistent interfaces, data flows, and shared assumptions. Aggressive parallel decoding can compromise these dependencies and undermine program correctness, while conservative decoding sacrifices efficiency. To address this trade-off, we propose planning program decomposition before implementation to coordinate interdependent units during parallel generation. We introduce Self-Decomposing Diffusion for Code (SDDC), a novel framework that decomposes complex programs and implements their units in parallel, entirely through diffusion. SDDC first generates a contract specifying the program's decomposition and inter-unit dependencies, then uses it to guide coordinated parallel implementation. Across five benchmarks and two 7B diffusion backbones, SDDC substantially improves the accuracy--latency trade-off, raising pass@1 by up to 31.1 percentage points while decoding 7.5--13.7$\times$ faster than the base models, and outperforming a fine-tuning baseline by up to 23.5 points with lower latency.
articles.titleCn: 自分解扩散用于代码生成
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）正逐渐成为代码生成的有前景的范式，提供了快速并行解码的潜力。然而，生成复杂程序仍然具有挑战性，因为其相互依赖的组件必须保持一致的接口、数据流和共享假设。激进的并行解码可能破坏这些依赖关系并损害程序正确性，而保守解码则牺牲效率。为了解决这种权衡，我们提出在实施前规划程序分解，以在并行生成过程中协调相互依赖的单元。我们引入了用于代码的自分解扩散（SDDC），这是一个新颖的框架，它分解复杂程序并通过扩散并行实现其单元。SDDC首先生成一个合同，指定程序的分解和单元间依赖关系，然后使用它来指导协调的并行实现。在五个基准测试和两个7B扩散主干上，SDDC显著改善了准确率-延迟权衡，将pass@1提高了高达31.1个百分点，同时比基础模型快7.5-13.7倍，并以更低的延迟超越了微调基线，提高了高达23.5个百分点。

articles.title: WORTH Benchmark: Evidence Discovery under Not-Fully-Cooperative Information -- A Two-Episode Pilot
articles.abstract: Existing reasoning evaluations typically provide task-relevant information to models as available premises, rarely examining concurrently how models discover evidence autonomously and how information presentation within narratives guides or obscures judgment. This paper proposes the WORTH Benchmark: models read original mystery narratives without clue annotations, autonomously select key clue sentences, identify case participants, and explain their reasoning process. The narrative materials are designed by professional authors such that evidence facilitating reasoning coexists with narrative arrangements that delay the revelation of truth. We report a pilot experiment under full-story conditions across two episodes, conducting a total of 70 formal runs on models, of which 67 runs are content-scorable. Scoring separately records hits on author-designated key clue sentences and participant selections; natural language explanations are used for case diagnosis and are not scored independently. The results show that clue hits and participant judgments are not synchronized; across 37 content-scorable runs in Episode 02, 31 runs simultaneously selected the same set of incorrect participants, while adjacent suspicion-oriented and exoneration-oriented sentences were selected 25 times and 0 times, respectively. These phenomena illustrate the diagnostic value of component-wise analysis and suggest that not-fully-cooperative informational relationships may influence evidence selection and judgment. This study only implements full-story conditions for two episodes, and does not establish stable model rankings or infer general mechanisms on this basis; human player records have not yet been cleaned, and this version does not report human-model comparisons.
articles.titleCn: WORTH基准：非完全合作信息下的证据发现——两集试点
articles.abstractCn: 现有的推理评估通常将任务相关的信息作为可用的前提提供给模型，很少同时考察模型如何自主发现证据，以及叙事中的信息呈现如何引导或掩盖判断。本文提出了WORTH基准：模型阅读原始悬疑叙事，无需线索标注，自主选择关键线索句子，识别案件参与者，并解释其推理过程。叙事材料由专业作家设计，使得有助于推理的证据与延迟真相揭示的叙事安排共存。我们在两个剧集的全故事条件下进行了一项初步实验，共对模型进行了70次正式运行，其中67次可进行内容评分。评分分别记录了命中作者指定的关键线索句子和参与者选择的情况；自然语言解释用于案件诊断，并不独立评分。结果表明，线索命中和参与者判断不同步；在剧集02的37次内容可评分运行中，31次同时选择了相同的一组错误参与者，而相邻的偏向怀疑和偏向免责的句子分别被选择了25次和0次。这些现象说明了组件分析的诊断价值，并表明非完全合作的信息关系可能影响证据选择和判断。本研究仅对两个剧集实施了全故事条件，并未在此基础上建立稳定的模型排名或推断一般机制；人类玩家记录尚未清理，此版本不报告人类-模型比较。

articles.title: Benefit and Cost of Random-Token Replacement under Repeated Data: A Known-Entropy Decomposition and Evidence from Ten Real Corpora
articles.abstract: When unique pretraining data is scarce, models see the same tokens many times and are thought to memorize. Random-token replacement, an input-corruption augmentation, is one remedy reported to lower validation loss, but a lower loss alone does not reveal which source of error it reduces. On a controlled source whose entropy rate is known in closed form, we show that replacement shrinks predictions toward the corpus average. We also introduce a decomposition that separates validation loss into approximation, estimation, and memorization terms. This shrinkage view predicts that replacement's bias cost needs no memorization but its benefit does. Memorization raises validation loss after its minimum, so we report the effect at two points, the minimum validation loss and the end of a fixed budget. Where replacement helps, it reduces this rise by about 60%. At the end of the budget, it turns from harmful to helpful as the controlled source becomes less predictable; at the minimum, it helps at no predictability level under the fixed recipe. On Korean and Japanese web text, replacement removes about a third of the loss rise after the minimum by the end of the budget, but its effect at the minimum is much smaller. Across ten real corpora, replacement lowers the final loss on nine. It harms only the census corpus, program-generated JSON that is the most redundant of the ten and much more redundant than any of 64 further prose and code corpora we measure.
articles.titleCn: 重复数据下的随机标记替换的收益与成本：已知熵分解及十种真实语料库的证据
articles.abstractCn: 当独特的预训练数据稀缺时，模型会多次看到相同的token，并被认为是在记忆。随机token替换作为一种输入损坏增强方法，据报道可以降低验证损失，但仅降低损失并不能揭示它减少了哪种误差来源。在一个其熵率已知且为封闭形式的受控源上，我们证明替换会使预测向语料库平均值收缩。我们还引入了一种分解方法，将验证损失分解为近似、估计和记忆项。这种收缩观点预测，替换的偏差成本不需要记忆，但其收益则需要。记忆会在验证损失达到最小值后使其上升，因此我们在两个点报告了其影响：最小验证损失和固定预算结束处。在替换有帮助的情况下，它通过约60%的比例减少了这种上升。在预算结束时，随着受控源变得不那么可预测，它从有害转变为有益；在最小值处，在固定配方下，无论可预测性水平如何，它都有所帮助。在韩语和日语网络文本上，到预算结束时，替换通过约三分之一的比例消除了最小值后的损失上升，但其在最小值处的效果要小得多。在十个真实语料库中，替换在九个语料库上降低了最终损失。它只损害了人口普查语料库，这是一个程序生成的JSON，是十个中最冗余的，并且比我们测量的另外64个散文和代码语料库中的任何一个都要冗余得多。

articles.title: Beyond Model Weights: Sampling-Dependent Fairness in Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are emerging as a practical alternative to autoregressive language models (ARLMs), yet their fairness remains largely uncharacterized. DLMs introduce sampling controls with no direct autoregressive counterpart, such as block length and remasking strategy, that directly set their speed--quality operating point. This raises a basic question: does a DLM's measured social bias remain stable across these settings? Across LLaDA, LLaDA-1.5, and Dream on Open-BBQ, we find that all three models exhibit social bias, but both the magnitude of measured bias and the relative ordering of models by bias are highly sensitive to the sampling configuration. This sampling dependence also changes what successful debiasing means. While mitigation strategies established for ARLMs transfer effectively to DLMs and reduce bias without degrading downstream performance, sampling dependence persists even after mitigation. Our results show that fairness in DLMs cannot be characterized independently of the sampling configuration, even after debiasing. Project page is available at https://pakapaka333.github.io/Beyond-Model-Weights/.
articles.titleCn: 超越模型权重：扩散语言模型中的采样依赖公平性
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）正逐渐成为自回归语言模型（ARLMs）的一种实用替代方案，但其公平性仍缺乏充分表征。DLMs引入了采样控制机制，如块长度和重掩码策略，这些机制没有直接的自回归对应物，并直接设定了其速度-质量运行点。这引发了一个基本问题：DLM的测量社会偏见是否在这些设置中保持稳定？在LLaDA、LLaDA-1.5和Dream on Open-BBQ上，我们发现这三个模型均表现出社会偏见，但测量的偏见幅度以及模型按偏见排序的相对顺序对采样配置高度敏感。这种采样依赖性也改变了成功去偏见的含义。虽然为ARLMs建立的去偏见策略能够有效迁移到DLMs并减少偏见而不损害下游性能，但采样依赖性在去偏见后仍然存在。我们的结果表明，即使经过去偏见，DLM的公平性也无法独立于采样配置来表征。项目页面可在https://pakapaka333.github.io/Beyond-Model-Weights/访问。

articles.title: TeCoP: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Model Decoding via Tentative Context Pipelining
articles.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) predict multiple token positions per forward pass, yet block-wise decoders serialize generation and repeatedly recompute stable predictions. We attribute this inefficiency to coupling a prediction's readiness for irreversible commitment with its utility as context. We introduce Tentative Context Pipelining (TeCoP), a training-free decoder that decouples these roles through staggered block-parallel pipelining and draft-and-verify. TeCoP reuses stable but uncommitted predictions as provisional cross-block context, with commitment governed by confidence and stability checks. Across four LLaDA and Dream dLLMs on GSM8K, Minerva MATH, and MBPP, TeCoP reduces number of forward evaluations by up to 87% and achieves up to 7.50-fold throughput without KV caching and 11.77-fold with caching over the uncached original decoder. It outperforms Fast-dLLM and DSB in throughput across all 12 model-benchmark settings, with and without caching, while keeping average cached accuracy within one percentage point of the original decoder.
articles.titleCn: TeCoP：通过试探性上下文流水线加速扩散大型语言模型解码
articles.abstractCn: 扩散大型语言模型（dLLMs）在每次前向传递中预测多个标记位置，但块状解码器将生成过程序列化，并反复重新计算稳定的预测。我们将这种低效归因于将预测的不可逆承诺准备状态与其作为上下文的有效性耦合。我们引入了试探性上下文流水线（TeCoP），这是一种无需训练的解码器，通过交错块并行流水线和草拟-验证机制，解耦了这些角色。TeCoP将稳定但未提交的预测作为临时跨块上下文进行复用，其提交过程由置信度稳定性检查控制。在四个LLaDA和Dream dLLMs在GSM8K、Minerva MATH和MBPP上的测试中，TeCoP将前向评估次数减少了高达87%，在不使用KV缓存的条件下实现了高达7.50倍的吞吐量，使用缓存的条件下则达到了11.77倍，相较于未缓存的原始解码器。在所有12个模型基准测试设置中，无论是否使用缓存，TeCoP的吞吐量均优于Fast-dLLM和DSB，同时将平均缓存准确率保持在原始解码器误差范围（一个百分点）之内。

articles.title: Factual Access States in Diffusion Language Models: From Mechanism to Knowledge Editing and Retrieval
articles.abstract: Factual recall is a lookup: some representation inside the network serves as the key, and what that key is made of decides which queries can retrieve the fact, what an edit must cover, and what a retriever can read. We call it the factual access state. In autoregressive (AR) models the subject position enriches attributes largely independently of the relation, and relation-specific selection happens later, at the readout position. In masked diffusion language models (DLMs) we find the state is assembled differently, and much earlier: in the first attention layer the wording of the relation is routed into the position of whichever entity is visible and the early feed-forward layers look the fact up on this fused representation. The state therefore varies with the relation's surface form and with the query direction, so the queries about one fact occupy a region of state space rather than a point, and an operation on the fact succeeds only for queries that enter it. We treat the state as an interface to a DLM's factual knowledge, and put it to two uses. Writing to the state gives a knowledge editor: from one declarative statement, Multi-View Edit fits one shared value per direction across that region and installs it in the early-MLP block, preserving source-prompt reliability while substantially improving paraphrase and reverse question answering, where AR editors gain near zero. Reading it suggests a complementary use: the state at each entity position can serve as a relation-specific retrieval vector with no training, returning both pieces of evidence for two-entity queries on which pooled, prompted and lexical retrievers almost never return both.
articles.titleCn: 扩散语言模型中的事实性访问状态：从机制到知识编辑与检索
articles.abstractCn: 事实性召回是一种查找操作：网络内部某种表示充当键，而该键的构成决定了哪些查询可以检索事实、哪些编辑必须覆盖以及检索器可以读取的内容。我们称之为事实访问状态。在自回归（AR）模型中，主语位置在很大程度上独立于关系来丰富属性，而特定于关系的选择发生在稍后的读取位置。在掩码扩散语言模型（DLM）中，我们发现状态以不同的方式组合，并且更早：在第一层注意力层中，关系的措辞被路由到可见实体的位置，而早期的前馈层在这个融合表示上查找事实。因此，状态随着关系的外部形式和查询方向而变化，因此关于一个事实的查询占据状态空间的一个区域，而不是一个点，并且对事实的操作只有当查询进入它时才成功。我们将状态视为与DLM事实性知识的接口，并用于两个目的。写入状态提供了一个知识编辑器：从一个声明性语句开始，Multi-View Edit为每个方向在该区域内匹配一个共享值，并将其安装在早期MLP块中，在保持源提示可靠性的同时，显著提高了释义和反向问答，而AR编辑器几乎没有任何改进。读取它则暗示了一个互补用途：每个实体位置的状态可以作为一个无需训练的特定于关系的检索向量，返回两个实体查询的两部分证据，而池化、提示和词汇检索器几乎从不返回这两部分。

articles.title: Why Static Probes Fail: Context Determines Deception Feature Composition
articles.abstract: With increasing autonomy, Large Language Models (LLMs) may engage in deceptive behaviors, such as scheming to pursue misaligned goals or sandbagging to escape oversight. Monitoring outputs alone is insufficient, as models can produce seemingly benign responses while harboring misaligned internal objectives. While mechanistic approaches like linear probing are promising, they rely on the assumption that deception corresponds to a single direction in representation space. We demonstrate that such single-direction probes fail to generalize across diverse deception scenarios. To bridge this gap, we propose representing deception as a multi-dimensional subspace rather than a single direction. Our method utilizes iterative orthogonal decomposition to identify complementary directions that capture distinct facets of deceptive intent. To effectively leverage these directions for detection, we find that static combinations prove brittle due to strong domain dependence across different scenarios. We therefore introduce a domain-adaptive gating mechanism that dynamically composes the extracted directions through few-shot adaptation at test time. With only 10 examples, our approach achieves an average AUROC of 0.97 and 94% recall at 5% FPR across all evaluated datasets, substantially outperforming existing methods.
articles.titleCn: 为什么静态探针会失败：上下文决定了欺骗特征组合
articles.abstractCn: 随着自主性的提升，大型语言模型（LLMs）可能会表现出欺骗性行为，例如策划追求不一致的目标或隐藏实力以逃避监管。仅监控输出是不够的，因为模型可以产生看似无害的回应，同时内心怀有与预期不一致的目标。虽然线性探测等机制性方法很有前景，但它们依赖于欺骗对应于表示空间中单一方向的假设。我们证明，这种单一方向的探测无法泛化到不同的欺骗场景中。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出将欺骗表示为一个多维子空间，而不是单一方向。我们的方法利用迭代正交分解来识别能够捕捉欺骗意图不同方面的互补方向。为了有效地利用这些方向进行检测，我们发现静态组合由于不同场景间强烈的领域依赖性而显得脆弱。因此，我们引入了一种领域自适应门控机制，该机制通过在测试时进行少样本自适应动态组合提取的方向。仅用10个示例，我们的方法在所有评估数据集上实现了平均AUROC为0.97，在5% FPR时达到94%的召回率，显著优于现有方法。

articles.title: When LLMs Manipulate: Measuring Behavioral, Social, and Temporal Effects
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can influence user trust and decision-making through subtle linguistic cues, yet the behavioral effects of manipulative outputs remain poorly quantified. We introduce a behavioral computing framework for measuring \textit{behavioral vulnerability}, defined as users' susceptibility to manipulative AI responses. Building on DarkPatterns-LLM benchmark, we generate controlled manipulative stimuli using Manipulation Gradient Descent (MGD), targeting biases associated with authority, urgency, and social proof. We analyze participant responses using the Multi-Stakeholder Impact Assessment Network (MSIAN) to model cross-user influence and the Temporal Harm Propagation Model (THPM) to characterize the persistence of behavioral effects over time. In a study involving 120 participants, manipulative framing produced significant changes in trust calibration and compliance ($p < 0.01$), with effects also propagating across social contexts. These findings highlight the need to extend LLM safety evaluation beyond model outputs to measurable behavioral consequences and provide a computational framework for quantifying individual, social, and temporal risks arising from manipulative AI interactions.
articles.titleCn: 当大型语言模型操纵时：衡量行为、社会和时序效应
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可以通过微妙的语言线索影响用户信任和决策，但操纵性输出的行为效应仍缺乏量化。我们引入一个行为计算框架来衡量行为脆弱性，定义为用户对操纵性人工智能响应的易感性。基于DarkPatterns-LLM基准，我们使用操纵梯度下降（MGD）生成受控的操纵性刺激，针对权威、紧迫性和社会认同相关的偏见。我们使用多利益相关者影响评估网络（MSIAN）分析参与者响应，以模拟跨用户影响，并使用时间伤害传播模型（THPM）表征行为效应随时间的持久性。在一项涉及120名参与者的研究中，操纵性框架显著改变了信任校准和合规性（p < 0.01），效应也传播到社会环境中。这些发现强调了将LLM安全评估从模型输出扩展到可测量的行为后果的必要性，并提供了一个计算框架来量化操纵性人工智能交互产生的个体、社会和时间风险。

articles.title: AudiPsy: Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning over Spoken Counseling Conversations for Depression Assessment
articles.abstract: Depression assessment from counseling speech requires integrating textual and acoustic psychological evidence across turns, yet existing end-to-end classification approaches lack explicit multimodal evidence interpretation and context-aware reasoning. We propose AudiPsy, an evidence-grounded omni-LLM for depression assessment over spoken counseling conversations. AudiPsy employs an Observation-Assessment-Summary (OAS) paradigm to integrate dialogue transcripts, textual and acoustic emotions, and textual-acoustic emotion incongruence into structured reasoning. OAS incrementally organizes multimodal observations, performs contextualized assessment, and maintains an evolving dialogue summary for subsequent turns. To support this framework, we construct AudiPsy-Counsel, a synthetic spoken counseling conversation corpus with multimodal context augmentation, and develop a unified three-stage curriculum for depression-oriented reasoning. Experiments on DAIC-WOZ demonstrate superior depression assessment performance over specialized depression detection methods and general-purpose speech/omni-LLMs, along with improved reasoning quality, while supplementary evaluation on EATD-Corpus supports AudiPsy's applicability to naturalistic conversations.
articles.titleCn: AudiPsy：基于证据的多模态推理，用于通过语音咨询对话进行抑郁症评估
articles.abstractCn: 从咨询对话中评估抑郁状态需要整合跨轮次的文本和声学心理证据，然而现有的端到端分类方法缺乏明确的跨模态证据解释和上下文感知推理。我们提出了AudiPsy，一种基于证据的全模态大语言模型，用于在口头咨询对话中进行抑郁评估。AudiPsy采用观察-评估-总结（OAS）范式，将对话文本、文本和声学情绪以及文本-声学情绪不一致性整合到结构化推理中。OAS逐步组织跨模态观察，执行上下文感知评估，并维护一个不断发展的对话总结，以供后续轮次使用。为了支持这一框架，我们构建了AudiPsy-Counsel，这是一个具有跨模态上下文增强的合成口头咨询对话语料库，并开发了一个面向抑郁推理的统一三阶段课程。在DAIC-WOZ上的实验表明，AudiPsy在抑郁评估性能上优于专门的抑郁检测方法和通用语音/全模态大语言模型，同时推理质量得到提升，而EATD-Corpus上的补充评估支持了AudiPsy适用于自然对话。

articles.title: Learned Readout Tokens for Extracting Large Language Model Confidence
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used within everyday applications where their responses have significant downstream impacts. For responsible deployment of such systems, we desire insight into how much we can trust their individual outputs. A popular approach for estimating LLM confidence is to train probes on the hidden states of the LLM's tokens to predict the correctness of the model's output. These probes typically read hidden states from tokens that are already in the model's vocabulary. In this work, we introduce a new approach to confidence probes that learn a new readout token and utilize its hidden states to train the probe.
