We show that our learned readout approach ScratchProbe outperforms its existing-token counterpart on a variety of datasets and LLMs. We also extend our method to a multi-token approach which we show provides further performance improvements. Finally, since the learned readout changes only the position a probe reads from, any existing probe can adopt it. Applied to a state-of-the-art probe, it improves AUROC on every backbone, in domain and out of domain.
articles.titleCn: 用于提取大型语言模型置信度的学习读出标记
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在日常应用中越来越普遍，其输出对后续任务具有重大影响。为了负责任地部署此类系统，我们希望了解可以多大程度上信任其单个输出。一种估计LLM置信度的流行方法是训练探针来预测LLM输出正确性，这些探针通常从模型词汇表中已有的标记中读取隐藏状态。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新的置信度探针方法，该方法学习一个新的读取标记，并利用其隐藏状态来训练探针。我们证明，我们的学习读取方法ScratchProbe在各种数据集和LLMs上优于其现有标记的对应方法。我们还扩展了我们的方法到多标记方法，并展示了它提供了进一步的性能提升。最后，由于学习读取仅改变探针读取的位置，任何现有探针都可以采用它。将其应用于最先进的探针，它在所有主干网络、领域内和领域外都提高了AUROC。

articles.title: AnomalyJev: Towards Evaluating Image Anomaly Explanations via Claim-Level Verification
articles.abstract: Recent multimodal LLM (MLLM)-based anomaly detection (AD) methods can generate textual explanations that help interpret their predictions. However, reliably and efficiently evaluating these explanations remains challenging. While LLM judges can assess explanations through structured rubrics, they often require substantial token generation, making evaluation costly and difficult to scale. We instead propose to anchor evaluation in the available ground truth by extracting verifiable claims from each explanation and verifying them against the corresponding annotations. We instantiate this idea as AnomalyJev, a lightweight framework that extracts verifiable claims from contextualised representations using ground-truth-defined queries and pointer based heads, without token generation. The claims are then verified against the ground truth to score faithfulness and completeness. For evaluation, we construct a human-annotated set of 640 explanations with over 1,600 expert ratings across in-domain and cross-dataset settings. Despite its compact design, AnomalyJev achieves stronger agreement with human annotators than most open MLLM judges and approaches that of flagship MLLM judges, at a fraction of their runtime and resources.
articles.titleCn: AnomalyJev：通过声明级验证评估图像异常解释
articles.abstractCn: 近年来，基于多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）的异常检测（AD）方法能够生成文本解释，以帮助理解其预测结果。然而，可靠且高效地评估这些解释仍然具有挑战性。虽然语言模型裁判可以通过结构化评分标准来评估解释，但这通常需要大量的标记生成，导致评估成本高昂且难以扩展。我们提出了一种基于可用真实标签进行评估的方法，通过从每个解释中提取可验证的声明，并将其与相应的标注进行验证。我们将这一理念具体化为AnomalyJev，这是一个轻量级框架，它使用真实标签定义的查询和基于指针的头部从上下文表示中提取可验证的声明，而无需生成标记。然后，这些声明将根据真实标签进行验证，以评分其忠实度和完整性。为了评估，我们构建了一个包含640个解释的人工标注数据集，涵盖了领域内和跨数据集设置，并收集了超过1600个专家评分。尽管AnomalyJev的设计紧凑，但它与人类标注者的协议性比大多数开源MLLM裁判和旗舰级MLLM裁判更高，同时其运行时间和资源消耗却少得多。

articles.title: Exploring Recurrent-Depth Language Models for Multitask Clinical Text Processing
articles.abstract: Clinical natural language processing includes diverse tasks such as information extraction, classification, and question answering. Developing one model for all tasks could simplify deployment and improve knowledge transfer. We evaluated whether small recurrent-depth language models can meet this need through joint fine-tuning and compared their performance with standard transformers. We fine-tuned Ouro1.4B-Thinking, Ouro-2.6B-Thinking, HRM-Text-1B, Qwen3-1.7B, and Qwen3-8B on 9 datasets covering information extraction, classification, inference, and question answering, and evaluated them on four additional datasets excluded from training. Across these 13 datasets, Ouro-1.4B-Thinking achieved higher performances than Qwen3-1.7B on 11 datasets; Ouro-2.6BThinking was competitive with Qwen3-8B on most tasks. Ouro models showed the largest gains on inference and question answering, whereas HRM-Text-1B showed mixed results. These findings support further study of recurrent-depth models for clinical tasks through controlled experiments to isolate architectural effects and investigate how recurrent computation influences reasoning, knowledge acquisition, and generalization.
articles.titleCn: 探索用于多任务临床文本处理的循环深度语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 临床自然语言处理包括信息提取、分类和问答等多样化任务。为所有任务开发单一模型可以简化部署并提升知识迁移能力。我们评估了小型递归深度语言模型是否可以通过联合微调满足这一需求，并将其性能与标准Transformer进行了比较。我们在9个涵盖信息提取、分类、推理和问答的数据集上微调了Ouro1.4B-Thinking、Ouro-2.6B-Thinking、HRM-Text-1B、Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-8B，并在训练集之外的4个数据集上进行了评估。在这13个数据集中，Ouro-1.4B-Thinking在11个数据集上表现优于Qwen3-1.7B；Ouro-2.6B-Thinking在大多数任务上与Qwen3-8B具有竞争力。Ouro模型在推理和问答任务上表现提升最大，而HRM-Text-1B则表现不一。这些发现支持通过受控实验进一步研究递归深度模型在临床任务中的应用，以分离架构效应并探究递归计算如何影响推理、知识获取和泛化能力。

articles.title: Can Native Safety Travel? Reusing Safety Pretraining Across Models via On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: Safety pretraining has emerged as a promising paradigm for embedding safety deeply into a model during pretraining, yielding robustness to subsequent fine-tuning that conventional safety post-training often lacks. We refer to this safety acquired during model pretraining as native safety. Yet native safety is expensive to acquire, confined to the model in which it was pretrained, and often accompanied by lower general utility. In this work, we rethink the practical value of safety-pretrained models and introduce, for the first time, the native safety reuse problem: Can native safety be transferred from a specialized, potentially smaller, safety-pretrained "teacher" to standard-pretrained "students," enabling them to inherit its robustness while preserving their general utility? We show that native safety can "travel" through on-policy distillation. A standard-pretrained student generates responses to safety-pretraining prompts, while a small safety-pretrained teacher supervises the student's token-level predictions along its own generated trajectories; cross-tokenizer alignment further enables transfer across model families. The resulting students exhibit substantially greater safety robustness than their safety-post-trained counterparts while retaining higher general utility than the teacher: subsequent fine-tuning raises the average attack success rate (ASR) of the 1.7B student by only 5.00%, compared with 11.58% for safety post-training, and its average utility of 48.20% far exceeds the aligned teacher's 27.42%. Unlike conventional large-to-small knowledge distillation, our framework enables selective, small-to-large safety transfer: it reuses the robust safety expertise of a smaller pretrained teacher without inheriting its utility limitations. These findings establish native safety as a reusable model property rather than one permanently tied to the originally pretrained model.
articles.titleCn: 本土安全旅行可行吗？通过策略蒸馏在模型间重用安全预训练
articles.abstractCn: 安全预训练已成为一种有前景的范式，它将安全深度嵌入模型中，从而在后续微调过程中获得传统安全后训练通常缺乏的鲁棒性。我们将模型预训练期间获得的安全称为原生安全。然而，原生安全的获取成本高昂，仅限于预训练的模型，并且通常伴随着较低的一般效用。在这项工作中，我们重新思考了安全预训练模型的实际价值，并首次引入了原生安全重用问题：原生安全能否从一个专门训练的、可能更小的安全预训练“教师”转移到标准预训练的“学生”，使他们能够继承其鲁棒性，同时保留其一般效用？我们表明，原生安全可以通过策略内蒸馏进行“迁移”。一个标准预训练的学生针对安全预训练提示生成响应，而一个小的安全预训练教师沿着其自身生成的轨迹监督学生的标记级预测；跨标记器对齐进一步实现了跨模型系列的迁移。最终产生的学生比其安全后训练的对应物表现出更高的安全鲁棒性，同时保留了比教师更高的通用效用：后续微调将1.7B学生的平均攻击成功率（ASR）仅提高了5.00%，而安全后训练提高了11.58%，其平均效用48.20%远超对齐教师的27.42%。与传统的从大到小的知识蒸馏不同，我们的框架实现了选择性的、从小到大的安全迁移：它重用了较小预训练教师的安全鲁棒性专长，而没有继承其效用限制。这些发现将原生安全确立为一种可重用的模型属性，而不是永久绑定到最初预训练的模型。

articles.title: EviDial: When Correct Depression Predictions Lack Evidence
articles.abstract: Depression dialogue benchmarks commonly assess models by comparing predicted symptom labels with clinical scale scores. However, a prediction may agree with a benchmark label even when the dialogue lacks enough evidence to justify it. We introduce EviDial, a benchmark that distinguishes label agreement from evidence-grounded assessment. EviDial comprises 382 depression dialogues from three sources and 2,744 participant-symptom cells, each classified as having absent, partial, conflicting, or sufficient evidence. Because evidence sufficiency lacks a directly observable gold standard, we derive calibrated evidence references from multiple judgments using generalizability theory, many-facet Rasch measurement, and random-effects latent class analysis. Our audit reveals that 82.8% of participant-symptom cells lack sufficient textual evidence for the corresponding symptom assessment, with substantial variation across sources. Across model families and prompting strategies, 69.2%-96.9% of predictions judged correct by benchmark labels are nonetheless unsupported by sufficient dialogue evidence. Further analyses show that strong agreement among LLM evaluators need not reflect independent evidence judgments, underscoring the need to calibrate automated reference panels. These findings demonstrate that label-based evaluation can overestimate evidence-grounded performance by conflating agreement with clinical labels and support in the observed dialogue. EviDial provides a measurement layer for separating these constructs and auditing LLM-based depression assessment more faithfully.
articles.titleCn: EviDial：当正确的抑郁症预测缺乏证据时
articles.abstractCn: 抑郁症对话基准通常通过比较预测症状标签与临床量表评分来评估模型。然而，即使对话缺乏足够的证据来支持预测，预测也可能与基准标签一致。我们引入了EviDial，一个能够区分标签一致性与证据支持评估的基准。EviDial包含来自三个来源的382段抑郁症对话，以及2,744个参与者-症状单元，每个单元被分类为缺乏证据、部分证据、矛盾证据或充分证据。由于证据充分性缺乏直接可观察的金标准，我们通过广义理论、多面Rasch测量和随机效应潜类分析从多个判断中推导出校准的证据参考。我们的审计显示，82.8%的参与者-症状单元缺乏足够的文本证据来支持相应的症状评估，且不同来源之间存在显著差异。在多种模型系列和提示策略下，被基准标签判断为正确的预测中，仍有69.2%-96.9%缺乏足够的对话证据支持。进一步分析表明，LLM评估者之间的高度一致未必反映独立的证据判断，这凸显了校准自动化参考面板的必要性。这些发现表明，基于标签的评估可能通过将一致性与临床标签和对话中的支持混淆而高估证据支持性能。EviDial提供了一个测量层，用于分离这些结构并更忠实地审计基于LLM的抑郁症评估。

articles.title: Judging the Justification: Decision Certificate Supervision for Generative Reward Models
articles.abstract: Generative reward models (GenRMs) generate natural language rationales to justify preference judgments, yet a correct verdict does not guarantee a sound justification. Existing approaches often rely on reference explanations to supervise rationales, but obtaining such references can be costly and does not necessarily establish whether generated rationales support the resulting verdict. To address these limitations, we propose DeCert, a framework that evaluates the validity and verdict consistency of generated rationales without requiring reference explanations. Crucially, DeCert translates these assessments into preference supervision that accounts for both verdict correctness and justification quality. In particular, when multiple sampled judgments share the same correct verdict, differences in certificate quality enable DeCert to construct rationale preference pairs that distinguish stronger from weaker justifications. Extensive empirical studies across two model families and multiple in- and out-of-distribution benchmarks demonstrate that DeCert consistently outperforms strong generative judge baselines while improving rationale quality. Moreover, DeCert effectively mitigates positional bias, improving position-consistent accuracy by up to 14.8 points. These results highlight the importance of supervising not only which verdict is correct, but also how that verdict is justified.
articles.titleCn: 评判合理性：生成式奖励模型的决策证书监督
articles.abstractCn: 生成式奖励模型（GenRMs）通过生成自然语言推理来论证偏好判断，但正确的判决并不保证有合理的论证。现有方法通常依赖参考解释来监督推理，但获取此类参考可能成本高昂，且不一定能确定生成的推理是否支持最终判决。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了DeCert，这是一个无需参考解释即可评估生成推理有效性和判决一致性的框架。关键在于，DeCert将这些评估转化为考虑判决正确性和论证质量的偏好监督。具体而言，当多个采样判决共享相同的正确判决时，证书质量的差异使DeCert能够构建区分强推理和弱推理的偏好推理对。在两个模型系列和多个分布内及分布外基准上的大量实证研究表明，DeCert始终优于强大的生成式裁判基线，同时提升了推理质量。此外，DeCert有效缓解了位置偏差，将位置一致性准确率提高了高达14.8个百分点。这些结果强调了监督不仅判决正确，还需监督判决论证方式的重要性。

articles.title: Self-Evolving Agents through Privileged Retrospective Distillation
articles.abstract: Self-evolving agents aim to improve from their own experience rather than remain fixed after deployment, but naturally collected trajectories often lack ground-truth solutions or verifier-derived rewards. We introduce Retrospective Self-Distillation (RSD), a multi-round framework that turns such experience into dense supervision using privileged retrospective context. For each on-policy trajectory, the same underlying model acts as both student and teacher: the teacher re-scores the student's realized actions while conditioning on cross-task precedents and lessons, together with turn-level reflection and future hindsight from the completed trajectory. The resulting teacher distribution is distilled back into the policy through on-policy self-distillation. Across rounds, the experience bank grows and the retrospective context is refreshed, allowing the model, its data, and its supervision to co-evolve. We further introduce frontier-guided context-policy evolution, where a stronger frontier model proposes constrained edits to how privileged context is constructed. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SearchQA with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B, RSD improves performance by up to 59.7% relative to the base model, while frontier-guided context-policy evolution adds up to a further 44.7% relative improvement over a fixed context policy. These results show that naturally accumulated experience can be converted into persistent model capability without ground-truth trajectories or verifier-derived rewards for the core policy update.
articles.titleCn: 通过特权回顾蒸馏实现自我进化的智能体
articles.abstractCn: 自进化智能体旨在通过自身经验进行改进，而非部署后保持固定，但自然收集的轨迹往往缺乏真实解或验证器派生的奖励。我们引入回顾性自蒸馏（RSD），这是一个多轮框架，利用特权回顾性上下文将此类经验转化为密集监督。对于每个在线策略轨迹，相同的底层模型同时充当学生和教师：教师基于跨任务先例和教训重新评分学生的实际动作，并结合回合级反思和已完成轨迹的未来洞察。由此产生的教师分布通过在线自蒸馏回蒸馏到策略中。在多轮中，经验库不断增长，回顾性上下文得到更新，使模型、其数据和其监督共同进化。我们进一步引入前沿引导的上下文策略进化，其中更强的前沿模型提出对特权上下文构建方式的约束编辑。在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和SearchQA上使用Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-14B，RSD相对于基础模型性能提升高达59.7%，而前沿引导的上下文策略进化在固定上下文策略基础上再提升了高达44.7%。这些结果表明，自然积累的经验可以在核心策略更新中无需真实轨迹或验证器派生的奖励，转化为持久的模型能力。

articles.title: Recoverability and Verifier Strength: Two Measured Preconditions for Unattended Agent Self-Improvement
articles.abstract: Agent platforms are starting to improve their own agents: they read a deployed agent's execution traces, derive a change, have an automated verifier approve it, and release it with no human author. How much of this loop can safely run without a human? We propose two quantities a platform can measure. Verifier strength $σ$ is how well the available verifier -- often an LLM judge -- agrees with a trusted reference verifier; it limits how much a step can improve the agent. Recoverability is how cheaply a bad change can be undone: whether undoing it needs a new verifier approval, and how much of the old behavior a rollback restores. A step should run unattended only if both are adequate. On our platform this rule allows prompt, tool and skill edits to run unattended and keeps weight updates under human sign-off. Our main contribution is these two definitions and how to measure them. We built a platform that applies the rule and tested it in two ways: on the platform's own approval gate, and in controlled experiments on the $τ^2$-bench agent benchmark. On verifier strength, the platform's LLM judge sometimes gave the same score no matter what it was shown (9 of 37 settings) and reported no error, so a verifier can look healthy while approving anything; its strength must be measured, and two simple tests catch the failure. On recoverability, restoring a saved copy brought the agent back to its original behavior, but a regenerated undo did not, so only changes whose old version is kept can be reversed without a human; and while a change was deployed, it altered the outcome of 17 percent of tasks beyond normal run-to-run variation, which no undo repairs. Together these support the rule: a change can run unattended only when its old version is kept and its verifier's strength has been measured.

articles.titleCn: 可恢复性与验证器强度：无人值守代理自我改进的两个衡量前提条件
articles.abstractCn: 代理平台开始自行改进其代理：它们读取已部署代理的执行轨迹，推导出变更，由自动化验证器批准，并以无人工作者的姿态发布。这个循环中有多少部分可以安全地无需人工干预？我们提出了平台可以测量的两个指标。验证器强度 $σ$ 是指当前验证器（通常是大型语言模型裁判）与可信参考验证器的一致程度；它限制了单个步骤可以改进代理的程度。可恢复性是指一个不良变更被撤销的成本：撤销是否需要新的验证器批准，以及回滚恢复了多少旧行为。只有当这两个指标都达标时，单个步骤才应无人值守运行。在我们的平台上，该规则允许提示、工具和技能编辑无人值守运行，并将权重更新控制在人工批准范围内。我们的主要贡献是这两个定义及其测量方法。我们构建了一个应用该规则的平台，并通过两种方式进行了测试：在平台自身的批准门禁上，以及在 $τ^2$-bench 代理基准的受控实验中。在验证器强度方面，平台的LLM裁判有时无论看到什么都会给出相同分数（37种设置中的9种），且未报告错误，因此验证器可能看似健康却会批准任何内容；其强度必须被测量，且两个简单的测试可以捕捉到这种失效。在可恢复性方面，恢复保存的副本使代理恢复到原始行为，但重新生成的撤销却做不到，因此只有保留旧版本的变更才能无需人工即可撤销；而在变更部署期间，它改变了17%的任务结果，超出了正常运行间的变异，撤销也无法修复。这些共同支持了该规则：只有当变更的旧版本被保留且验证器强度被测量时，变更才能无人值守运行。

articles.title: Detecting Errors in Large Language Model Responses: The Incremental Predictive Value of Hidden States
articles.abstract: Although large language models support a wide range of tasks, hallucinations remain a major obstacle to user trust. When a model generates an answer, both its internal processing and final output vary with the question. Internal states are often expected to offer richer signals for hallucination detection. However, studies using these states typically report their standalone discrimination performance, while output-side comparisons often use simple baselines with weaker modeling capacity. We integrate output-side information available at inference time into a combined baseline and compare detection performance before and after adding hidden states under identical data splits and evaluation rules. Experiments cover open-ended generation and constrained multiple-choice tasks across different models. Adding hidden states improves AUROC by approximately 0.004 and 0.039 on the two tasks, respectively. Hidden states thus provide additional predictive information, but strong standalone detection performance can still yield only limited additional gains.
articles.titleCn: 检测大型语言模型响应中的错误：隐藏状态的增量预测价值
articles.abstractCn: 尽管大型语言模型支持广泛的任务，但幻觉现象仍然是影响用户信任的主要障碍。当模型生成答案时，其内部处理过程和最终输出都会随着问题的不同而变化。内部状态通常被认为能为幻觉检测提供更丰富的信号。然而，使用这些状态的研究通常仅报告其独立判别性能，而输出端的比较则常采用建模能力较弱的简单基线。我们将推理时可用的输出端信息整合到一个组合基线中，并在相同的数据划分和评估规则下，比较添加隐藏状态前后的检测性能。实验涵盖了不同模型在开放式生成和约束性多选题任务上的表现。添加隐藏状态分别使这两个任务的AUROC提升了约0.004和0.039。因此，隐藏状态确实提供了额外的预测信息，但强大的独立检测性能仍然只能带来有限的额外增益。

articles.title: Ask to Distill: Learning to Synthesize Data for On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) can succeed with surprisingly few training questions, motivating a view of questions as carriers of distributional knowledge transfer. How can we assess whether a newly generated question is valuable for distillation, and learn to generate better questions---without access to its correct answer? We introduce Ask-to-Distill (\method), a framework that treats synthetic questions as distribution elicitors and optimizes the teacher supervision they expose along student-generated trajectories. A student-initialized synthesizer is optimized using a distributional surrogate for question value, computed from a frozen student--teacher pair without reference answers, correctness rewards, or per-candidate student updates. The reward combines teacher--student disagreement with teacher probability mass on the student's candidate support, together with length and diversity controls. The generated questions are filtered and deduplicated into a prompt-only bank for standard OPD. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and agentic tasks, our method improves average performance and teacher-gap recovery over unoptimized student-generated prompts and KL-filtered real questions, while matching or exceeding real-bank OPD in the evaluated settings. Signal analyses further show that optimized questions can elicit denser supervision and more total signal from shorter student responses, supporting elicited distributional supervision as an objective for synthetic distillation data. Our code, data and models are publicly available at https://github.com/GasolSun36/Ask_to_Distill.
articles.titleCn: 请求蒸馏：学习为策略内蒸馏合成数据
articles.abstractCn: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）仅需极少的训练问题即可成功，这促使我们将问题视为分布知识迁移的载体。我们如何评估新生成的问题是否对蒸馏有价值，并学会生成更好的问题——而无需获取其正确答案？我们引入了Ask-to-Distill（\method）框架，该框架将合成问题视为分布诱导器，并优化其在学生生成轨迹中暴露的教师监督。学生初始化的合成器通过一个分布替代指标进行优化，该指标从冻结的学生-教师对中计算得出，无需参考答案、正确性奖励或针对每个候选答案的学生更新。奖励结合了教师与学生之间的分歧、教师对学生候选答案支持的概率质量，以及长度和多样性控制。生成的问

articles.title: Harness Self-Evolution for Long-Horizon Terminal Agents
articles.abstract: Long-horizon terminal agents may solve a task in one run yet fail across repeated runs. Stochastic errors can propagate through actions and context, creating a gap between capability and reliable execution. We present RiseHarness, a framework for iteratively improving agent harnesses with model weights fixed. It focuses on flipping tasks with both successful and failed runs under the same configuration, using successful runs as references for failure analysis. RiseHarness combines agent trajectories with internal harness traces from a runtime monitor to examine how model actions interact with command execution, feedback, context management, and completion decisions. A Harness Handbook links this evidence to harness behaviors and source code, helping identify recurring problems in mechanisms shared across tasks. RiseHarness then searches other harness frameworks for relevant implementations and adapts them as design references to the current model and execution protocol. Candidate changes undergo behavioral checks and repeated task evaluation; versions with measured gains seed the next iteration. This loop integrates suitable mechanisms from different frameworks into a single harness and uses new execution evidence to guide further changes. We evaluate task success and reliability across models, ablate harness execution evidence and external research, and test transfer to unseen benchmarks with the same model. RiseHarness treats a specific model as the unit of harness adaptation, studying how changes to shared interaction mechanisms can make existing capabilities more reliable across tasks.
articles.titleCn: 利用自我进化实现长时程终端智能体
articles.abstractCn: 长时程终端代理可能在单次运行中完成任务，但在多次运行中失败。随机误差会通过动作和上下文传播，造成能力与可靠执行之间的差距。我们提出了RiseHarness框架，该框架在模型权重固定的情况下，通过迭代改进代理适配器。它专注于翻转在相同配置下既有成功运行又有失败运行的任务，并使用成功运行作为失败分析的参考。RiseHarness结合代理轨迹和运行时监控器提供的内部适配器跟踪信息，以检查模型动作如何与命令执行、反馈、上下文管理和完成决策相互作用。一个适配器手册将证据链接到适配器行为和源代码，帮助识别跨任务共享机制中的重复问题。RiseHarness随后在其他适配器框架中搜索相关实现，并将它们作为当前模型和执行协议的设计参考进行适配。候选变更会经过行为检查和重复任务评估；具有可测量收益的版本将作为下一轮迭代的种子。这个循环将不同框架中的合适机制集成到一个适配器中，并使用新的执行证据来指导进一步变更。我们对不同模型的任务成功率和可靠性进行评估，消融适配器执行证据和外部研究，并在使用相同模型的情况下测试对未见过的基准的迁移。RiseHarness将特定模型视为适配器改进的单位，研究对共享交互机制的变更如何使现有能力在任务中更加可靠。

articles.title: The Router Already Knows
articles.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models already make a sparse choice for every token: which experts should process it. We ask whether a sparse dictionary should reuse that choice. NR-SAE gives each routed expert a small dictionary and opens only those the frozen router selects. At block 15 of Gemma 4 26B-A4B, after ten million C4 training tokens and across three seeds, the expert-aligned autoencoder explains 0.518 of the variance in router-weighted expert outputs on a fixed evaluation capture. A rank-addressed control with the same parameters but sixteen times as many candidates reaches 0.481, a candidate-matched control 0.458, and an architecture-matched control with randomized expert identity 0.387. A transcoder variant also leads all three controls: 0.432, against 0.347, 0.371, and 0.118. Part of this advantage is architectural: each expert writes into a subspace of at most a quarter of the model width, so naming the expert names the subspace. How much it explains, we have not measured. At this layer and budget, the router already knows something a dictionary would otherwise have to learn. Our implementation did not train faster, and semantic interpretability, downstream loss, and causal faithfulness remain untested.
articles.titleCn: 路由器已经知道了
articles.abstractCn: 混合专家模型（MoE）已经为每个词元做出了稀疏选择：哪些专家应该处理它。我们探讨了稀疏字典是否应该重用这一选择。NR-SAE 为每个路由专家分配一个小字典，并仅打开冻结路由器选择的那些。在 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 的第 15 个块中，经过一千万个 C4 训练词元，并在三个种子下，专家对齐的自编码器在固定评估捕获中对路由加权专家输出的方差解释了 0.518。具有相同参数但候选者数量多十六倍的秩寻址控制在 0.481，候选者匹配控制在 0.458，而随机专家身份的架构匹配控制在 0.387。一种转码器变体也使这三种控制在 0.432、0.347、0.371 和 0.118 中表现最佳。部分优势在于架构：每个专家写入模型宽度最多四分之一的空间子集，因此命名专家即命名了该子集。其解释程度我们尚未测量。在此层和预算下，路由器已经知道了一些原本需要字典学习的信息。我们的实现并未加速训练，语义可解释性、下游损失和因果忠实度仍待测试。
